ev:1-absolute-luck:a-gull-s-share.html: The food hits the water, and half the flock goes after it, screaming at each other. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Fowl Weather.

ev:1-absolute-luck:a-hard-landing.html: The bark tears away under your fingers, and the ground turns out to be exactly as hard as it looks. Whoever climbed starts the coming fight with one card in their improvisation deck. GO TO Woodlands, and choose a different option.

ev:1-absolute-luck:a-murder-of-crows.title: A Murder of Crows
ev:1-absolute-luck:a-murder-of-crows.html:
As you turn to go, the coins throb with a sickly light, whether they're in your pack or still up the tree. The crow screams, and the canopy answers: black wings pour down from every branch, with the same light in their eyes.

A Murder of Crows
Quarter
Enemy
Flock
Outcome
Victory
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

If you won, the light goes out of the crows' eyes, and they scatter over the treetops, free of whatever bound them to the gold. You watch them go for a long time. You know a thing or two about curses. STOP READING. If you lost, the flock settles back into the oak, to keep its watch. STOP READING.

ev:1-absolute-luck:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:1-absolute-luck:deserts.html:
For an hour, the shimmer on the horizon refuses to go away. It turns out to be an oasis, and a real one: you check twice, the second time with your whole face in the water. Palm shade, sweet water, and a pool so clear you can count the coins at the bottom, thrown in for luck by travelers long gone.

Until you leave this location, you may rest sheltered here, at the cost of 1 curse.

Each player may dive for the coins with a Trial 3 BODY (Athletics), and gains 3 gold if they succeed. Then, GO TO Laughing Stock.

ev:1-absolute-luck:fowl-weather.title: Fowl Weather
ev:1-absolute-luck:fowl-weather.html:
They come at you beak first, and they don't much care which of you is holding the food.

Fowl Weather
Quarter
Enemy
Flock
Outcome
Victory
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • Players lose 1x Food item.
  • 3 exp for each player.

If you won, the wind holds, and the last gulls fall away astern: you may move to a connected Ocean sector. Win or lose, GO TO another day at sea.

ev:1-absolute-luck:laughing-stock.title: Laughing Stock
ev:1-absolute-luck:laughing-stock.html:
You're still dripping when the laughter starts. A pack of hyenas has come down to drink, a great many of them, and they've found something better than water.

Laughing Stock
Quarter
Enemy
6×Pack Predator (#2)
Additional Rules
  • When two Pack Predators have died, the rest flee, and you win the fight.
Outcome
Victory
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:1-absolute-luck:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:1-absolute-luck:mountains.html:
The mouth of a cave shelters a lit campfire undisturbed by the buffeting wind, casting its lazy light over a collection of abandoned supplies.

You gain 2x random common Travel items, and 2x random common Food items.

You may rest sheltered here now, at the cost of 1 curse.

Rest or not, as you leave the cave, GO TO Rime and Punishment.

ev:1-absolute-luck:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:1-absolute-luck:oceans.html:
For once, the sea behaves. The wind holds steady at your back, and nothing with teeth takes an interest in you. Then the gulls find your stores: one, then ten, then a shrieking white cloud, diving for anything you might have meant to eat.

Choose one
  • Drop the sail over the stores, and read the gusts to hold it there. Trial 4 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO under the sail. If you fail, GO TO the sail flaps loose.
  • (Lose a Food item) Throw them something to fight over. GO TO a gull's share.
  • Swat at them with whatever's handy. GO TO Fowl Weather.

ev:1-absolute-luck:plains.title: Plains
ev:1-absolute-luck:plains.html: Two bandits step out from behind a haystack and demand your purses. One of them is holding his sword by the wrong end. The other is looking at him as if he'd only just noticed. GO TO Wrong End of the Sword.

ev:1-absolute-luck:the-crow-s-bargain.html: The crow considers your offer with one black eye, then the other. It flies up, works at the branch for a while, and drops something at your feet before making off with your lunch. GO TO the crow's prize.

ev:1-absolute-luck:the-crow-s-prize.html:
It's a purse stitched with a noble's crest, heavy with coin. Tangled in its strings is a little stoppered vial the crow was clearly saving for a special occasion.

You gain 8 gold and 1x random Common Potion. GO TO A Murder of Crows.

ev:1-absolute-luck:the-sail-flaps-loose.html: A gust tears the canvas out of your hands and wraps it round your head. By the time you're out, they've been at the biscuit. The party is Worn: every player starts the fight with one card in their improvisation deck. GO TO Fowl Weather.

ev:1-absolute-luck:towns.title: Towns
ev:1-absolute-luck:towns.html:
Your stomach grumbles as you lay your eyes on a bustling tavern. The sounds of music, raucous laughter, and multiple simultaneous scuffles reaches you through the thick wooden doors. Above them a weathered sign depicts a crudely drawn animal, barely recognizable under a layer of blackened grease.

GO TO tavern decision.

ev:1-absolute-luck:under-the-sail.html: The canvas snaps down over the stores, and the first gulls bounce off it in a flurry of offended feathers. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Fowl Weather.

ev:1-absolute-luck:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:1-absolute-luck:woodlands.html:
A crow keeps landing on the same branch of an enormous oak, pecking at something that glints, then flying off in disgust. Whatever it is, it's shiny, it's stuck, and it's a very long way up.

Choose one
  • Climb for it. Trial 4 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, GO TO the crow's prize. If you fail, GO TO a hard landing.
  • (Spend a Food item) Offer the crow a better deal. GO TO the crow's bargain.
  • Leave the crow to its problem. GO TO A Murder of Crows.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:a-bargain.html: The voice laughs, delighted, and while it's still laughing, the goods are in your hands and your blade is out. You gain 1x random Rare Weapon and 1x random Rare Armor, and +1 curse. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Out of the Breach.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:a-free-sampl.html: It tastes of pears, then of pennies. Roll the trial die. If it's positive, you feel wonderful: you get +1 to your trials until you next rest, as a food gives. If it's negative, you feel something else entirely: discard the top 2 cards of the adventure deck. If it's zero, you turn faintly purple for an hour, and that's all. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:a-loud-landi.html: You reach the valley floor faster than you meant to, and much louder. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO The Valley of Jewels.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:a-pocketful-.html: You fill your pockets, then your boots, then your hat. You're halfway back up the cliff when the sun goes dark again. You gain 20 gold and 1x random Rare Travel item. GO TO The Valley of Jewels.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:caught-nappi.html: You find it curled up in the dark, fast asleep, and get in a good few blows before it understands what's happening. The Towering Beast starts the fight with one extra life fewer. GO TO Under the Floorboards.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:deserts.html:
From the canyon's rim, you can see the valley floor glitter: diamonds, rubies, gems the size of eggs, scattered like gravel among bones the size of houses. High above the valley, a bird is circling, so big that the sun goes dark each time it passes: a Roc, watching over its larder.

Choose one
  • Climb down and fill your pockets. Trial 6 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, GO TO a pocketful of jewels. If you fail, GO TO a loud landing.
  • (Lose a Food item) Throw some meat down among the jewels for them to stick to, and follow the Roc when it carries the meat up to its nest. GO TO the merchants' trick.
  • Wait on the rim with your blades ready, and let it come to you. GO TO The Valley of Jewels.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:letting-go.html: It lets you, and sends what's behind it instead. GO TO Out of the Breach.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:mountains.html: Nestled between two rock outcroppings lies a massive nest, crafted from sturdy branches, foliage and the occasional bone of uncertain provenance. Before you can wisely decide to get on your way, the familiar glint of steel catches your eye. Something shines among the branches. GO TO approach the unidentified nest.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:oceans.html:
The sea ahead turns in a slow circle a mile wide, around a chain. It rises from the water like the trunk of an impossible tree, each link taller than a temple, and disappears into the low clouds. Frost furs the steel despite the midday sun. As you watch, the chain draws taut with a groan you feel in your teeth, and the whole ocean leans towards it.

Something at the bottom of the sea is pulling. Your raft has already begun to drift into the circle.

Choose one
  • Read the current and sail along the edge of the circle, where its pull is weakest. Trial 9 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO sail clear of the chain. If you fail, GO TO into the maelstrom.
  • (Spend a SOUL card). Pray to Adrai'lalth for deliverance. Trial 6 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO the chain goes slack. If you fail, GO TO into the maelstrom.
  • Steer straight for the chain. “If we can't outrun it, we climb it.” GO TO climb the chain.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:out-of-the-b.title: Out of the Breach
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:out-of-the-b.html:
The breach tears wider, and whatever is on the other side comes pouring through: embers first, then legs, dozens and dozens of legs, and then the thing they belong to.

Out of the Breach
Crescent
EnemyExtra Lives
Emberskitter Matriarch (#21)
Quarter
Enemy
Emberskitter Sack (#20)
Full Moon
Enemy
Emberskitter Spiderlings (#19)
Additional Rules
  • The breach closes when the Emberskitter Matriarch dies, and you win.
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Rare Weapon, left behind in the ashes.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:plains.title: Plains
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:plains.html:
In the middle of a burned field, the air has split open like old canvas: a breach as tall as a door, with a red glow far below. A grey, long-fingered hand in a rusted iron cuff reaches out of it and beckons to you. Further down, something glowing like embers climbs towards it on far too many legs.

Choose one
  • (Spend a SOUL card) Pray to Adrai'lalth to close the breach. Trial 6 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO the breach narrows. If you fail, GO TO Out of the Breach.
  • Take the hand. GO TO the hand's offer.
  • Draw your weapons, and wait at the breach for whatever climbs out. GO TO Out of the Breach.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:something-ta.html: You leave the bait at the hole and wait beside it. It comes out nose first, sniffing, and finds you there. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Under the Floorboards.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:soul-in-the-.html: It doesn't hurt, exactly. The witch corks two flasks that glow faintly, and hums while she does it. You gain 2x random Rare Potion. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:strength-in-.html: She tips your supplies into the cauldron, and stirs for an hour. She ladles out a flask of something red and thick, still warm. You gain 1x random Rare Potion. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-alchemis.html:
ItemPrice
3x random Uncommon PotionItem value
2x random Rare PotionItem value
Flask of Obliteration (Rare Potion #2)Item value

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-breach-n.html: The light of your prayer pours into the gap like water into a crack, and the edges begin to knit. Not fast enough to stop everything. Fast enough to stop a good deal. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Out of the Breach.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-grip-tig.html: The grip tightens, and pulls, and you come away from the breach with something clinging to your arm. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Out of the Breach.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-hand-s-o.html:
The hand is warm, and grips yours like an old friend's. A voice speaks inside your head, reasonable and a little bored. “You'll be mine in the end anyway. Why not sell early, while the price is good?”

Choose one
  • (+2 curse) Sell. GO TO the sale.
  • Haggle. Trial 10 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO a bargain. If you fail, GO TO the grip tightens.
  • Let go. GO TO letting go.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-hut-on-h.title: The Hut on Hen's Legs
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-hut-on-h.html:
The hut rears up, flinging its door wide, and out come the witch, her wolves, and something huge and brown that had been sleeping under the floor.

The Hut on Hen's Legs
Crescent
Enemy
Pack Predator (#2)
Quarter
Enemy
Towering Beast (#6)
Full Moon
EnemyExtra Lives
Witch (#26)
Additional Rules
  • The hut fights too: at the end of each round, it stamps, and every player loses 1 stamina.
Outcome
Victory
  • 2x random Rare Potion, from the witch's shelves.
  • 1x random Rare item and 20 gold, from under the floorboards.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-merchant.html: The meat lands among the jewels, and they stick to its fat like flies. Before long the Roc drops out of the sky, seizes the meat and carries it off to its nest on the canyon's rim, a short climb from where you stand. You're there before it has finished its first mouthful. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO The Valley of Jewels.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-sale.html: The voice names a price you hear with something other than your ears. When you look down, the goods are in your hands, and something is missing from inside you. The voice keeps its word, to the letter. It never said it would close the breach. You gain 1x random Rare Weapon and 1x random Rare Armor. GO TO Out of the Breach.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-witch-s-.html:
“Square,” the witch agrees, and sets a cauldron on the fire. “Now. I can make you something special, if you have something to put in.” You may rest sheltered here tonight, at the cost of 2 gold.

Choose one
  • (Lose 2 Food items) Put in your supplies. GO TO strength in the pot.
  • (+1 curse) Put in a little piece of your soul. GO TO soul in the pot.
  • Thank her for the meal, and leave. STOP READING.

The door is opened by an orc woman in an apron, with a ladle in one hand and a string of little bottles clinking at her throat. “Guests!” she says. “Sit, sit. You'll eat first, and then we'll talk about the price.”

The stew is the best you've ever had. Afterwards, she wipes her hands and points the ladle at the floor. “Something's moved in under my hut. It snores, it stinks, and it's eaten two of my wolves. Get it out, and we'll call it square.”

Choose one
  • (Lose a Food item) Lure it out with something tastier than wolf. GO TO something tastier.
  • Crawl under the hut after it. Trial 6 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, GO TO caught napping. If you fail, GO TO the wrong end.
  • Stamp on the floor until it comes out. GO TO Under the Floorboards.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:the-wrong-en.html: It's dark under the hut, and you find the wrong end first. It wakes up the right end. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Under the Floorboards.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:towns.title: Towns
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:towns.html:
A crooked little shop leans against the town wall, its windows fogged from the inside. The sign over the door says ALCHEMIST, and the smell agrees. Inside, an old woman with no eyebrows is stirring a pot of something green and bubbling.

Choose one
  • Browse the shelves. GO TO the alchemist's shelves.
  • Accept a free sample. GO TO a free sample.
  • Leave before the smell gets into your clothes. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:under-the-fl.title: Under the Floorboards
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:under-the-fl.html:
The floor heaves, the hut squawks and hops aside, and something huge and brown comes up out of the dirt, very cross.

Under the Floorboards
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
Towering Beast (#6)
Outcome
Victory
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

If you won, GO TO the witch's cauldron. If you lost, the witch shakes her head, and shuts the door. STOP READING.

ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:10-the-chain-in-the-deep:woodlands.html:
A hut stands in the clearing on two enormous hen's legs, scratching idly at the dirt. Smoke curls from its chimney with a smell of stew, mostly wonderful. On the doorstep, a wolf the size of a pony watches you with polite interest. From under the floorboards comes a snore, much bigger than the wolf.

Choose one
  • Knock. GO TO the witch's supper.
  • (+2 curse) Burn it down, witch and all. GO TO The Hut on Hen's Legs.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:a-door-closed-.html: He closes the door in your face, gently. STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:a-rut-freshly-.html: The rut has spade marks in it. Somebody dug it last night, and filled it with water, and is waiting to see who gets stuck. You turn to the ditch before the ditch is ready. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Stuck in the Mud.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:brass-tacks.title: Brass Tacks
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:brass-tacks.html:
The sand pours off the brass as it stands, and stands, until its head scrapes the roof of the cave. Smaller brass things crawl out after it, swinging and crackling.

Brass Tacks
Quarter
Enemy
Arc Sentry (#8)
Full Moon
EnemyExtra Lives
Lodestone Warden (#30)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Rare Travel item, wrapped in goatskin: the hermit's gift, or what you took from him.
  • If you robbed him: 10 gold more, his savings.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:deserts.html:
A thread of smoke leads you to a cave above the dunes, where a hermit lives with a goat and a great many opinions. Behind him, at the back of the cave, a brass hand the size of a cart sticks up out of the sand. He hangs his washing on it.

Choose one
  • Sit down and listen. Trial 5 SOUL (Resolve), to stay awake. If you succeed, GO TO the hermit's prophecy. If you fail, GO TO the third age of the world.
  • Help him dig out whatever he keeps buried under the hand. Trial 5 BODY (Might). If you succeed, GO TO dug out. If you fail, GO TO dug in.
  • (+1 curse) Take whatever he's buried, and leave him to the goat. GO TO the hermit robbed.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:dug-in.html: You dig until your arms burn, and the sand runs back in as fast as you shift it. You're still wiping your brow when the brass hand closes. The party is Worn: every player starts the fight with one card in their improvisation deck. GO TO Brass Tacks.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:dug-out.html: You dig fast, and you've cleared the hand, the arm and most of a shoulder before anything under the sand thinks to stop you. Half of it is still buried when it wakes. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Brass Tacks.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:in-hot-water.title: In Hot Water
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:in-hot-water.html:
It rises out of the pool, and keeps rising. The steam freezes as it pours off its fur, and the frost on the rocks gets up to join it.

In Hot Water
Crescent
Enemy
Rimelings (#29)
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
Ice Troll (#7)
Outcome
Victory
  • If you haven't taken it yet: Giant Egg (Rare Food #1), from the bottom of the pool.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

If you won, the pools are yours: you may rest sheltered here now, at the cost of 1 curse. STOP READING. If you lost, STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:mountains.html:
Steam rises from a ring of pools high on the mountain, warm as a bath and smelling faintly of eggs. Something large and white is sitting in the biggest one, eyes closed, humming. Around the pools, the snow is littered with the bones of other bathers.

Choose one
  • Creep up while it soaks, and strike while the heat has it slow. Trial 5 BODY (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO soaked through. If you fail, GO TO the yeti wakes.
  • Hold your breath, and dive for the egg it's boiling at the bottom of the pool. Trial 5 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO the yeti's egg. If you fail, GO TO the yeti wakes.
  • Wake it with a snowball. GO TO In Hot Water.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:oceans.html:
A little island rises out of the sea, green and quiet, with a spring and a stand of palms. You haul the raft up its beach, drink your fill, and stretch out in the shade. Then the island sneezes, and the beach begins to move: crabs, hundreds of them, pouring out of the sand, every one the size of a shield.

Choose one
  • Lie still, and hum to the island until it settles. Trial 6 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the island settles. If you fail, GO TO the island thrashes.
  • Read the tide lines on the shell, and find the high ground. Trial 5 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO the high ground. If you fail, GO TO the low ground.
  • Run for the raft, and fight your way there. GO TO Shell Shock.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:plains.title: Plains
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:plains.html:
A merchant wagon lists at an alarming angle beside the road. Three armored guards stand around it, looking sternly at a wheel sunk to its axle in mud. Their employer sits on a crate, fanning herself with a ledger. The mud is suspiciously fresh, and the long grass in the ditch beside it is suspiciously still.

“Excellent,” she calls. “Someone without a contract forbidding manual labor.”

Choose one
  • Put your shoulder to the wheel and shame the guards into pushing with you. Trial 5 SOUL (Might, Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the wheel comes free. If you fail, GO TO the wagon settles deeper.
  • Take a closer look at the rut. Trial 5 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO a rut, freshly dug. If you fail, GO TO Stuck in the Mud.
  • Walk over to the ditch with your blade drawn. GO TO Stuck in the Mud.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:shell-shock.title: Shell Shock
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:shell-shock.html:
Shell Shock
Quarter
Enemy
5×Pack Predator (#2)
Additional Rules
  • Hold out: at the end of round 4, the island dives and takes the crabs with it. If you're still fighting, you win.
Outcome
Victory
  • 2x Platefin (Common Food #1), from the shallows.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • The island dives with your raft still on its back, and you're shipwrecked.
  • 3 exp for each player.

If you won, you reach the raft as the island goes under, and it surfaces again a mile away, and swims off with a long, contented groan. GO TO another day at sea. If you lost, GO TO Shipwrecked.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:soaked-through.html: It's been soaking for hours, and the heat has got right into it. It comes out of the water slow, and steaming. The Ice Troll starts the fight burned. GO TO In Hot Water.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:stuck-in-the-m.title: Stuck in the Mud
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:stuck-in-the-m.html:
Highwaymen come up out of the grass with mud on their faces, and crossbows behind them in the ditch.

Stuck in the Mud
Crescent
Enemy
Bandit (#1)
Full Moon
Enemy
Poacher (#4)
Outcome
Victory
  • The merchant pays you, and pointedly doesn't pay her guards: 6 gold.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-gilded-goo.html:
Inside, the wine is good, the harpist is better, and the gossip is the best in town.

Everyone gains 1 EXP, and you hear rumours of one special location on this landmass: turn to its page, and read only its rumour section.

If you rest in this town tonight, you may take rooms here: you rest sheltered, at the cost of 2 gold each. STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-hermit-rob.html: You push the old man aside, and he sits down hard next to his goat, and for the first time in twenty years, he stops talking. You dig under the hand, and something under the hand digs back. GO TO Brass Tacks.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-hermit-s-p.html: At dawn he finally stops, looks at you properly, and nods. “You listened. Nobody listens. So listen to this: never dig past the elbow.” Then he goes to the back of the cave, and digs past the elbow. You're already on your feet when the brass hand closes. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Brass Tacks.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-high-groun.html: You find the ridge of the shell, above the tide marks, where the crabs have to climb to reach you, and most of them don't bother. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Shell Shock.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-island-set.html: It's an old song, and the island seems to know it. It stops shivering, and starts to sink, slowly and contentedly, which is better than quickly. It dives a round sooner: at the end of round 3 instead of 4. GO TO Shell Shock.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-island-thr.html: The island doesn't care for your humming. It bucks, the palms whip, and you go down in a heap among the crabs. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Shell Shock.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-low-ground.html: You scramble up what you think is the ridge, and slide all the way back down it. The party is Worn: every player starts the fight with one card in their improvisation deck. GO TO Shell Shock.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-third-age-.html: You nod off somewhere in the third age of the world, and wake at dawn with sand in your ears. He's still talking, and he's digging at the back of the cave, and the brass hand is slowly closing. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Brass Tacks.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-wagon-sett.html: The guards discover a sudden interest in the horizon, and the wagon settles deeper, and so do you. You're knee-deep in the rut when the ditch stands up. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Stuck in the Mud.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-wheel-come.html: Three armored backs join yours, and the wheel comes free with a wet pop, just as the ditch stands up. The guards have their swords out before the first bolt flies, and they're glad of the company. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Stuck in the Mud.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-yeti-s-egg.html: You come up gasping, with an egg the size of your head, boiled to perfection, and the yeti's nose an inch from yours. You gain Giant Egg (Rare Food #1). GO TO In Hot Water.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:the-yeti-wakes.html: The yeti opens one eye, then its mouth. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO In Hot Water.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:towns.title: Towns
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:towns.html:
Off the main square, a tall townhouse glows behind leaded windows. A gilded goose hangs over its door, and whenever the door opens, harp music drifts out into the street. The doorman steps into your path. His only job, it seems, is to look at people the way he's looking at you now.

Choose one
  • (-5 gold) Pay the doorman's “Shackle surcharge”. GO TO the Gilded Goose.
  • Remind him that the Shackle isn't catching. Trial 6 MIND (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the Gilded Goose. If you fail, GO TO a door closed gently.
  • Find somewhere cheaper. STOP READING.

ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:11-skeletons-roc-brawl:woodlands.html:
Tucked away beneath thick foliage, you notice the hard wooden edge of a chest. Though you can't make it out in its entirety behind the leaves, it appears sturdy and unspoiled by rot. It's also the only thing in the clearing that the leaves haven't buried, as if someone wanted it found.

Trial 4 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO avoiding the trap. If you fail, continue reading.

You begin to hack away at the foliage, slowly carving a path to the chest. As wet branches crushed underfoot join the sound of your knife, you notice a metallic glint by the corner of your eye. GO TO Booby trapped chest.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:a-camel-s-opinion.html: The camels have opinions about being stampeded, and share them with you at length, mostly by biting. The party is Worn: every player starts the fight with one card in their improvisation deck. GO TO Sand in the Wheels.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:a-cub-squeals.html: You step on a cub. It squeals. The bracken explodes. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Grin and Bear It.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:a-few-good-storie.html: The war band likes your stories, and likes their witch rather less. When she whistles for her wolves, the orcs sit on half the leashes, and cheer. Everyone gains 1 EXP. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Pass Fail.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:a-frog-in-the-thr.title: A Frog in the Throat
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:a-frog-in-the-thr.html:
The frogs don't want to go overboard. They make this very clear.

A Frog in the Throat
Quarter
Enemy
5×Warpfrog (#25)
Outcome
Victory
  • If you carry the Magister's jar, a frog hops into it: you have a frog in a jar.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • Each player loses 1x Food item: the frogs ate it.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, GO TO another day at sea.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:a-sailful-of-frog.html: The sail bellies with frogs, and you tip them over the side in a great green heap before they've worked out where they are. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO A Frog in the Throat.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:a-sleeper-stirs.html: You step on an orc. He doesn't wake up, quite, but he rolls over onto a leash, and lets one more wolf loose. The fight is Reinforced: one enemy more in each group. GO TO Pass Fail.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:a-sporting-start.html: He considers this, and agrees that it would be unsporting not to. He gives you to the count of a hundred, and counts slowly, and loses his place twice. You spend it well. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO The Most Dangerous Game.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:a-story-too-many.html: One of your stories is about an orc. The witch stops smiling. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Pass Fail.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:deserts.html:
From the ridge, you watch raiders fall on a merchant caravan in the valley below. The caravan's guards are holding, but only just.

Choose one
  • Circle round, and stampede the caravan's camels through the raiders' line. Trial 6 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, GO TO the stampede. If you fail, GO TO a camel's opinion.
  • Ride down the ridge to the caravan's rescue. GO TO Sand in the Wheels.
  • (+2 curse) Join the raiders, for a share of the spoils. GO TO Honor Among Thieves.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:honor-among-thiev.title: Honor Among Thieves
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:honor-among-thiev.html:
The raiders make room for you without a word. The caravan's guards are sladeri mercenaries, and they close ranks as you come.

Honor Among Thieves
Crescent
Enemy
Ironclad Soldier (#16)
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
Ironclad Ranger (#18)
Outcome
Victory
  • Your share of the spoils: 30 gold, 1x random Rare item and 1x random Uncommon Travel item.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:mountains.html:
An orc war band is camped in the pass, most of it snoring off last night. The wolves tethered by the fire aren't asleep, and neither is the witch stirring the cauldron. She looks up, straight at you, and smiles.

Choose one
  • Walk into the camp with your hands open, and tell the war band your stories. Trial 6 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO a few good stories. If you fail, GO TO a story too many.
  • Creep in while they sleep. Trial 6 BODY (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO still snoring. If you fail, GO TO a sleeper stirs.
  • Go straight for the witch. GO TO Pass Fail.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:no-sport-at-all.html: “Nonsense,” says the baron, and the hounds are on you before he's finished saying it. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO The Most Dangerous Game.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:oceans.html:
The sky is clear, the sea is calm, and it's raining frogs. They thump onto the raft by the dozen, croaking, and the ones you shove overboard turn up again a moment later, dripping, in the water barrel and down the back of your shirt.

Choose one
  • (Everyone spends a card) Row out from under the cloud, and leave most of them behind. GO TO out from under the cloud.
  • Spread the sail to catch them as they fall, and tip them into the sea. Trial 6 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO a sailful of frogs. If you fail, GO TO the sail gives way.
  • Bail them overboard. GO TO A Frog in the Throat.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:out-from-under-th.html: You row until the frogs stop falling. The ones already aboard come with you, and they're not happy about it. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO A Frog in the Throat.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:pass-fail.title: Pass Fail
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:pass-fail.html:
The witch whistles, and the wolves slip their tethers. Behind her, the war band goes on snoring.

Pass Fail
Crescent
Enemy
Pack Predator (#2)
Full Moon
EnemyExtra Lives
Witch (#26)
Outcome
Victory
  • 6 gold.
  • 1x random Uncommon Weapon.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:plains.title: Plains
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:plains.html:
Hunting horns sound across the grassland, and a party of riders crests the hill: a baron in green velvet, with his huntsmen and his guards. He reins in, looks you over, and brightens. “Shackled! Splendid. The deer were getting predictable.”

Choose one
  • Remind him that a good hunt needs a fair start. Trial 6 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO a sporting start. If you fail, GO TO no sport at all.
  • Run for the river, and make the hounds lose your scent. Trial 6 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, GO TO the scent lost. If you fail, GO TO no sport at all.
  • Stand and fight. GO TO The Most Dangerous Game.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:protection-money.title: Protection Money
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:protection-money.html:
The thin man sighs, and the alley fills up with his colleagues.

Protection Money
Crescent
Enemy
Bandit (#1)
Quarter
Enemy
Ringleader (#12)
Outcome
Victory
  • The day's collections: 8 gold.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • Everyone loses half their gold, rounded up.
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:sand-in-the-wheel.title: Sand in the Wheels
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:sand-in-the-wheel.html:
You hit the raiders from behind, and for a moment, they don't know which way to face. Then their chief rides out of the dust with a blade in each hand, and shows them.

Sand in the Wheels
Crescent
Enemy
4×Bandit (#1)
Quarter
Enemy
Marauder (#33)
Outcome
Victory
  • The grateful merchant pays you: 10 gold and 1x random Uncommon Travel item.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:slow-and-careful.html: The cubs follow you, curious, and their mother comes out of the bracken slow and careful, so as not to frighten them. You're ready for her. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Grin and Bear It.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:someone-else.html: He considers this, and decides the guild has noticed someone else. STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:something-for-the.html: The cubs fall on your supplies, and one of the big bears stops to share them. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Grin and Bear It.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:still-snoring.html: You're across the camp before the wolves lift their heads. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Pass Fail.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:the-most-dangerou.title: The Most Dangerous Game
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:the-most-dangerou.html:
The baron blows his horn, and his huntsmen spread out through the grass while his guards close in, laughing.

The Most Dangerous Game
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
Royal Guard (#24)
Full Moon
Enemy
Poacher (#4)
Outcome
Victory
  • The baron flees, and leaves his purse behind: 8 gold.
  • 1x random Uncommon Weapon.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:the-sail-gives-wa.html: The sail fills, and keeps filling, and tears, and drops a season's worth of frogs on your heads. The fight is Reinforced: one enemy more in each group. GO TO A Frog in the Throat.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:the-scent-lost.html: You splash downstream until the hounds are baying at an empty bank, and the huntsmen with them. Only the baron's guards find you, and they're out of breath. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO The Most Dangerous Game.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:the-stampede.html: The camels go through the raiders like a flood through a fence, and leave a good many of them face down in the sand. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Sand in the Wheels.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:towns.title: Towns
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:towns.html:
You cut through a narrow alley to avoid the market crowds. A thin man falls into step beside you, and two large ones fall into step behind. “The guild,” says the thin one, “has noticed you. The guild likes to be paid for noticing.”

Choose one
  • (Everyone loses 3 gold) Pay. “Pleasure doing business.” STOP READING.
  • Explain that the Shackled make very poor victims. Trial 6 MIND (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO someone else. If you fail, GO TO Protection Money.
  • Refuse. GO TO Protection Money.

ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:12-the-baron-s-hunt:woodlands.html:
Two bear cubs tumble out of the bracken, see you, and squeak. Somewhere behind them, something much bigger stops eating.

Choose one
  • Back away slowly, and keep the cubs between you and whatever stopped eating. Trial 5 BODY (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO slow and careful. If you fail, GO TO a cub squeals.
  • (Lose a Food item) Toss the cubs your supplies. GO TO something for the cubs.
  • Stand your ground. GO TO Grin and Bear It.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:a-convincing-stor.html: His story is so moving that you're still wiping your eyes when the dead climb over the churchyard wall behind you. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Saints Preserve Us.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:a-rude-awakening.title: A Rude Awakening
ev:13-the-relic-seller:a-rude-awakening.html:
The monk sets down her tray, very carefully, and bows. So do the three brothers who appear behind her, from nowhere, in total silence. They've stopped smiling.

A Rude Awakening
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
Brawler (#14)
Outcome
Victory
  • The monastery's offerings: 25 gold, 2x Rice Balls (Uncommon Food #3), Wooden Beads (Uncommon Travel #5) and 1x random Rare Travel item.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:a-tastier-morsel.html: The tentacle takes the food, considers it, and lets go of your ankle to get a better grip on it. The Ice Troll starts the fight with one extra life fewer. GO TO Arm's Length.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:arm-s-length.title: Arm's Length
ev:13-the-relic-seller:arm-s-length.html:
Arm's Length
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
Ice Troll (#7)
Additional Rules
  • The Ice Troll is the kraken's arm: it grows back as the troll heals, unless it's burned.
Outcome
Victory
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • The kraken takes the raft, and you're shipwrecked.
  • 3 exp for each player.

If you won, the arm lets go, and the sea boils as something vast sulks away. GO TO another day at sea. If you lost, GO TO Shipwrecked.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:caught-red-handed.title: Caught Red-Handed
ev:13-the-relic-seller:caught-red-handed.html:
A sentry's lamp swings round, and the whole camp wakes at once, the way only soldiers can.

Caught Red-Handed
Crescent
Enemy
Ironclad Soldier (#16)
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
Ironclad Protector (#17)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Uncommon Armor, from the wagon.
  • If you didn't get away with the blade already: 1x random Rare Weapon.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • Everyone loses half their gold, rounded up: the sladeri charge for their trouble.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:caught-with-a-spa.html: His story has more holes in it than the churchyard, and there's fresh earth under his nails. He sees you see it, drops his bells, and runs, just as the first grave behind him sits up. You were watching the churchyard already. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Saints Preserve Us.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:13-the-relic-seller:deserts.html:
A mercenary camp sprawls around a well: sladeri, in iron and scarves, resting between contracts. Their quartermaster runs a stall from the back of a wagon, and beside it, in a ring of spears stuck in the sand, two of them are fighting for the fun of it. To her, business is business, Shackled or not, once they've seen you bleed.

Choose one
  • Watch a bout first, then step into the ring. Trial 5 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO you've seen his tricks. If you fail, GO TO First Blood.
  • Step straight into the ring. GO TO First Blood.
  • (+1 curse) Come back after dark, and help yourselves. Trial 6 BODY (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO the best blade on the wagon. If you fail, GO TO Caught Red-Handed.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:first-blood.title: First Blood
ev:13-the-relic-seller:first-blood.html:
The camp's champion steps into the ring, rolls his shoulders, and grins.

First Blood
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
Marauder (#33)
Additional Rules
  • Only one player fights. The others watch: they don't play cards, and can't be targeted.
  • It's to first blood: the champion yields as soon as you win, and stops as soon as you lose.
Outcome
Victory
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • Nobody dies in the ring. Losing costs no curse.
  • 3 exp for each player.

Win or lose, GO TO the quartermaster's wagon.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:holy-orders.title: Holy Orders
ev:13-the-relic-seller:holy-orders.html:
The pilgrim squeals, and three large men who had been napping under the cart remember what they're paid for.

Holy Orders
Quarter
Enemy
Ironclad Protector (#17)
Full Moon
Enemy
Ironclad Soldier (#16)
Outcome
Victory
  • His takings: 25 gold, Wooden Beads (Uncommon Travel #5) and 2x random Uncommon Potion, the goddess's tears.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:morning-practice.title: Morning Practice
ev:13-the-relic-seller:morning-practice.html:
Morning Practice
Quarter
Enemy
Brawler (#14)
Additional Rules
  • It's practice: nobody dies, and the brothers stop as soon as you win or lose.
Outcome
Victory
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • The brothers help you up, smiling. Losing costs no curse.
  • 3 exp for each player.

Win or lose, GO TO the monks' offerings.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:13-the-relic-seller:mountains.html:
A monastery clings to the cliff above the path, all red roofs and prayer flags, and a bell rings as you climb towards it. At the gate, a monk in saffron waits with a tray of tea, as if she'd been expecting you. Behind her, in the courtyard, brothers in bare feet are throwing each other across the flagstones, smiling.

Choose one
  • Accept the tea, and join the morning practice. GO TO the morning practice.
  • (+2 curse) Knock the tray aside, and rob the place. GO TO A Rude Awakening.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:13-the-relic-seller:oceans.html:
A tentacle as thick as a mast rises beside the raft, feels its way along the logs like a blind man reading, and finds your ankle. Wherever you cut it, it grows back.

Choose one
  • (Lose a Food item) Offer it something tastier, and hit it while it chews. GO TO a tastier morsel.
  • Keep perfectly still, and remember what the old sailors say about krakens. Trial 7 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO the soft spot. If you fail, GO TO the kraken pulls.
  • Hack at it. GO TO Arm's Length.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:one-breath.html: You breathe with them until you can't tell their breath from yours, and when they move, you're already moving. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Morning Practice.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:out-of-breath.html: The air is thin up here, and you run out of it long before they do. The party is Worn: every player starts the fight with one card in their improvisation deck. GO TO Morning Practice.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:plains.title: Plains
ev:13-the-relic-seller:plains.html:
A painted cart stands at the crossroads, hung with little bells and a portrait of Adrai'lalth that someone has touched up, generously, in gold leaf. Its owner, a round man in a pilgrim's robe, spreads his arms at the sight of you. “Pilgrims! Relics, blessings, holy water. Everything the faithful need, at prices the faithful can afford.” Behind him, every grave in the churchyard has been opened, recently, and very carefully.

Choose one
  • Look over his relics. GO TO the relic cart.
  • Ask him where his relics come from. Trial 6 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO caught with a spade. If you fail, GO TO a convincing story.
  • (+1 curse) Relieve him of his takings. GO TO Holy Orders.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:returned-to-sende.html: A few of the dead stop to pick it up, and lie back down with it, satisfied. The rest keep coming. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Saints Preserve Us.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:saints-preserve-u.title: Saints Preserve Us
ev:13-the-relic-seller:saints-preserve-u.html:
The dead come out of the churchyard in their burial clothes, slow and determined, and at their head walks a tall skeleton with a halo of rusted wire, missing one finger.

Saints Preserve Us
Crescent
Enemy
4×Raised Bones (#3)
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
Raised Commander (#10)
Outcome
Victory
  • Wooden Beads (Uncommon Travel #5), which nobody is coming back for now.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:she-only-watches.html: The painted goddess only watches. STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:she-s-listening.html: For a moment, you're sure she's listening. Everyone gains 2 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:tended.html: The priestess binds your wounds quickly, and well, and doesn't meet your eyes. She makes up beds in the back, as far from the altar as they'll go. If everyone paid, you may rest sheltered here tonight. STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-best-blade-on.html: You slip out of the camp with the best blade on the wagon, and you're past the well when a sentry's lamp swings round, and finds you first. You gain 1x random Rare Weapon. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Caught Red-Handed.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-churchyard-st.html:
You're still counting your change when the churchyard behind the cart begins to stir. Saint Oswin, it seems, would like his finger back, and he's brought the congregation.

Choose one
  • (Lose an item you bought here) Throw a relic back over the churchyard wall. GO TO returned to sender.
  • Stand your ground. GO TO Saints Preserve Us.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-elves-wares.html:
They drop from the branches without a sound, and unroll a cloak on the moss.

ItemPrice
2x random Uncommon Food itemItem value
Longbow (Common Weapon #6)Item value
1x random Uncommon PotionItem value
1x random Rare WeaponItem value

Once you're done, they roll up the cloak, and nock their arrows again. “Now you'll stand with us,” says the elf. “They're here.” With the elves shooting from the branches, the fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO War Party.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-kraken-pulls.html: The tentacle tightens, and pulls. The raft tilts, and the sea comes up over the logs. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Arm's Length.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-monks-offerin.html:
The monks sell what they make: prayer beads, tea, and rice wrapped in leaves. For those who need it, they also offer a night of silence.

ItemPrice
Wooden Beads (Uncommon Travel #5)Item value
2x Rice Balls (Uncommon Food #3)Item value
A night in the monastery3 gold each

If everyone pays for a night in the monastery, you rest here tonight, sheltered, and each player gains 2 EXP from the evening's meditation.

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-morning-pract.html:
“Guests practise with us,” the monk says, “before they trade with us. It is how we pray.” Two of the brothers bow to you from the middle of the courtyard.

Choose one
  • Breathe with them first, as they do. Trial 5 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO one breath. If you fail, GO TO out of breath.
  • Step out onto the flagstones. GO TO Morning Practice.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-next-arrow.html: The next arrow lands a finger from your boot. “Back the way you came,” says the elf. You go back the way you came, and meet their company coming the other way: orcs, a war party of them, and they're glad to see you. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO War Party.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-offering.html: The priestess drops your coins into the box without looking at them, or at you. That night, for the first time in a long while, you sleep without dreaming of chains. You made an offering to the goddess. Everyone gains 3 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-quartermaster.html:
The quartermaster lets down the tailboard of her wagon. If you lost, every price is 2 gold more: the sladeri respect a winner.

ItemPrice
2x random Common WeaponItem value
2x random Uncommon ArmorItem value
1x random Rare WeaponItem value + 3 gold

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-relic-cart.html:
A finger bone of Saint Oswin. A splinter from the goddess's cradle. A vial of her tears, slightly cloudy.

Trial 6 SOUL (Resolve), to tell the holy from the hopeful. If you succeed, you find the few real things among the fakes, and he knows that you know: you may buy anything below for half its price. If you fail, you pay in full.

ItemPrice
Wooden Beads (Uncommon Travel #5)Item value
2x random Uncommon Potion, the goddess's tearsItem value
1x random Rare Travel itemItem value

Once you're done trading, GO TO the churchyard stirs.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:the-soft-spot.html: You find the soft spot behind the suckers, and pinch. The tentacle recoils, and when it comes back, it comes back warily. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Arm's Length.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:towns.title: Towns
ev:13-the-relic-seller:towns.html:
The town's temple of Adrai'lalth is small, and very clean. A priestess is sweeping the steps as you arrive. She sees the Shackle and stops sweeping, then, after a moment, starts again, a little faster. Inside, the goddess watches from the painted wall, one hand raised in blessing. The other hand is behind her back.

Choose one
  • (Lose 20 gold, without an offering to the goddess) Make an offering. GO TO the offering.
  • (3 gold for each player tended) Ask to be tended, and to stay the night. GO TO tended.
  • Pray. Trial 6 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO she's listening. If you fail, GO TO she only watches.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:war-party.title: War Party
ev:13-the-relic-seller:war-party.html:
The orcs come through the trees at a run, and their champion runs at the front with a blade in each hand, roaring.

War Party
Crescent
Enemy
Bandit (#1)
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
Marauder (#33)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Uncommon Food item: elven waybread, from the elves, if they're still speaking to you, or from the orcs' packs.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:13-the-relic-seller:woodlands.html:
Three arrows thud into the tree beside your head, in a neat line. In the branches above, three elves sit with their bows drawn, looking bored. “Stop there, Shackled,” says one, in the tone of someone who has said it many times. “State your business in our wood. Quickly. We're expecting company, and it isn't you.”

Choose one
  • Ask to trade. Elves don't trade with just anyone. Trial 6 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the elves' wares. If you fail, GO TO the next arrow.
  • (+1 curse) Shoot first. GO TO An Arrow Escape.

ev:13-the-relic-seller:you-ve-seen-his-t.html: The camp's champion favours his left, drops his guard when he grins, and grins a lot. When he steps into the ring with you, you're waiting for the grin. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO First Blood.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:a-glancing-blow.html: The raft glances off the longboat's bow, and you spend a long time untangling the oars. The party is Worn: every player starts the fight with one card in their improvisation deck. GO TO Knives Out.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:a-lungful.html: You breathe in halfway through, and the smoke breathes in with you. The party is Worn: every player starts the fight with one card in their improvisation deck. GO TO Up in Smoke.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:a-successful-experime.html: Nothing hatches. The wizard pays you in coin and gratitude, mostly for that. You gain 8 gold. Everyone gains 2 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:14-tolls-of-war:deserts.html:
A dust cloud on the horizon resolves into riders in white and gold, the emir's banner snapping over them. Their captain reins in beside you. “By order of the Emir, all travelers pay the water tax.” He looks at your waterskins. “Half.”

Choose one
  • (Everyone loses a Food item) Pay, and go thirsty. GO TO the tax paid.
  • Tell him you ride for the Emir yourselves, on business he'd rather not know about. Trial 6 MIND (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the Emir's business. If you fail, GO TO the Emir's seal.
  • Refuse. GO TO Tax Evasion.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:fairy-ring.title: Fairy Ring
ev:14-tolls-of-war:fairy-ring.html:
Every frog in the ring turns to face you at once.

Fairy Ring
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
5×Warpfrog (#25)
Outcome
Victory
  • If you carry the Magister's jar, a frog hops into it: you have a frog in a jar.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

If you lost, you wake up outside the ring, some distance away: move to a random adjacent location. STOP READING. If you won, the ring is yours to use, once: you and your allies may move to any location up to 3 locations away. STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:fire-eats-smoke.html: The backfire roars into the drifting clouds, and they scatter from it like sheep, straight back towards you, in no kind of order. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Up in Smoke.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:frostbitten.title: Frostbitten
ev:14-tolls-of-war:frostbitten.html:
The frost gets up off the rocks on a great many small, sharp legs, and behind it, something big and grey that has been eating the travellers the toll didn't help.

Frostbitten
Crescent
Enemy
Rimelings (#29)
Quarter
Enemy
Ice Troll (#7)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Uncommon Armor, from a frozen traveller.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:inside-out.html: The frogs look at your coat, and then at each other, and don't seem to know what to make of you. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Fairy Ring.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:knives-out.title: Knives Out
ev:14-tolls-of-war:knives-out.html:
The pirates come over the side all at once, and their captain comes last, still grinning.

Knives Out
Crescent
Enemy
Bandit (#1)
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
Ringleader (#12)
Outcome
Victory
  • 8 gold, and take back any items you set aside.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • Any items you set aside are gone. If you set none aside, each player loses an item of common or uncommon rarity.
  • 3 exp for each player.

Win or lose, the longboat rows away. GO TO another day at sea.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:more-smoke.html: The backfire catches, and makes a great deal of smoke, all of it hungry. The fight is Reinforced: one enemy more in each group. GO TO Up in Smoke.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:14-tolls-of-war:mountains.html:
Someone has built a wall across the pass, with a gate and a squat stone tower, and a dwarf in a very large helmet is leaning out of its window. “Toll,” he says. “Two gold a head. Five for Shackled.”

Choose one
  • (Everyone loses 5 gold) Pay. GO TO through the gate.
  • Argue that the Shackled are people too. Trial 7 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the normal rate. If you fail, choose a different option.
  • Go over the wall. GO TO Tolls of War.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:14-tolls-of-war:oceans.html:
A longboat full of pirates pulls alongside, and a woman with a knife in each hand stands in its bow, grinning. “Nice raft,” she says. “We'll take whatever's on it.”

Choose one
  • (Each player sets aside an item of common or uncommon rarity) Hand over your valuables. GO TO pleasure doing business.
  • Read the longboat's trim, and ram it where it sits lowest in the water. Trial 6 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO shipping water. If you fail, GO TO a glancing blow.
  • Fight for your belongings. GO TO Knives Out.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:one-foot-wrong.html: The ring is wider than it looks, or it moves. Your foot comes down on a mushroom. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Fairy Ring.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:plains.title: Plains
ev:14-tolls-of-war:plains.html:
A grass fire has swept this stretch of the plains, leaving it black to the horizon. The flames are long gone, but the smoke isn't. It drifts low over the ash in little clouds, against the wind, and it's drifting towards you.

Choose one
  • Hold your breath, and walk through it to the far side, where it's thinnest. Trial 6 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO the thin side. If you fail, GO TO a lungful.
  • Light a backfire, and let the wind carry it into them. Trial 6 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO fire eats smoke. If you fail, GO TO more smoke.
  • Stand your ground. GO TO Up in Smoke.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:pleasure-doing-busine.html: “Pleasure doing business,” she says, and passes your valuables back to her crew, who start squabbling over them at once. Then she looks at the raft. She meant all of it. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Knives Out.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:shipping-water.html: The raft hits the longboat where it's low, and the sea pours in over the side. Half the pirates drop their knives and grab buckets. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Knives Out.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:tax-evasion.title: Tax Evasion
ev:14-tolls-of-war:tax-evasion.html:
The captain sighs, the way officials do everywhere, and his riders draw their swords.

Tax Evasion
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
Royal Guard (#24)
Outcome
Victory
  • 8 gold and 1x random Uncommon Armor, from the riders' saddlebags.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • The riders take their tax anyway: everyone loses a Food item.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:the-emir-s-business.html: The captain hesitates, which is all you needed him to do. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Tax Evasion.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:the-emir-s-seal.html: “Then you'll have the Emir's seal,” says the captain, and holds out his hand. You don't. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Tax Evasion.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:the-normal-rate.html: He grumbles, and charges you the normal rate. Then, as the gate swings open, he looks a little ashamed of himself, and leans out of the window. “Mind the pass,” he says. “Toll pays for the wall. Not for what's past it.” Everyone loses 2 gold. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Frostbitten.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:the-tax-paid.html: The captain takes your water, and hands it to his riders, and then looks at your wrist. “The Emir pays a bounty on the Shackled, too.” Half his riders have already ridden off with the waterskins. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Tax Evasion.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:the-thin-side.html: You come out of the smoke on the far side, eyes streaming, with most of it still drifting the wrong way behind you. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Up in Smoke.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:the-wizard-s-wares.html:
The wizard's shelves groan with wands, staves, and jars of things that are mostly dead.

ItemPrice
Birch Wand (Common Weapon #3)Item value
Oak Staff (Common Weapon #4)Item value
Chromatic Staff (Uncommon Weapon #2)Item value
2x random Uncommon PotionItem value
1x random Rare PotionItem value

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:the-wrong-tale.html: It was a different tale, it turns out, about a different kind of ring. The frogs find it very funny. The party is Worn: every player starts the fight with one card in their improvisation deck. GO TO Fairy Ring.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:through-the-gate.html: The gate swings open on a pass white with frost, and full of things that crunch. The toll, it turns out, pays for the wall, not for what's on the other side of it. GO TO Frostbitten.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:tolls-of-war.title: Tolls of War
ev:14-tolls-of-war:tolls-of-war.html:
You're halfway up the wall when the helmet shouts something in dwarvish, and the tower empties.

Tolls of War
Quarter
Enemy
Ironclad Protector (#17)
Full Moon
EnemyExtra Lives
Ironclad Ranger (#18)
Outcome
Victory
  • The toll box: 12 gold.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • Everyone loses 5 gold: the toll, and a fine.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:towns.title: Towns
ev:14-tolls-of-war:towns.html:
A tower leans over the town's rooftops at an angle that makes the neighbours nervous. The sign on its door reads: WIZARD. ENCHANTMENTS, IDENTIFICATIONS, MINOR CURSES LIFTED. NO FROGS. The last line looks recent.

Choose one
  • Browse the wares. GO TO the wizard's wares.
  • Offer to help with an experiment. Trial 6 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO a successful experiment. If you fail, GO TO Experimental Results.
  • Leave before anything else goes wrong. STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:up-in-smoke.title: Up in Smoke
ev:14-tolls-of-war:up-in-smoke.html:
The clouds gather into shapes with a great many teeth, and one of them gathers into something much bigger.

Up in Smoke
Crescent
Enemy
4×Soot Biter (#5)
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
Soot Devourer (#23)
Outcome
Victory
  • 2x random Common Food item, from the cellar of a burned farmstead.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:well-around-it.html: You give the ring a wide berth, and only the boldest frogs blink out of it after you. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Fairy Ring.

ev:14-tolls-of-war:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:14-tolls-of-war:woodlands.html:
In a hollow among the oaks, a ring of pale mushrooms glows faintly in the dusk. Inside it, a dozen frogs sit perfectly still, watching you. Every so often, one of them blinks out of existence, and back in again, facing a different way.

Choose one
  • Turn your coat inside out, as the old tales say, and step into the ring. Trial 5 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO inside out. If you fail, GO TO the wrong tale.
  • Walk around it. Well around it. Trial 6 BODY (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO well around it. If you fail, GO TO one foot wrong.
  • Step into the ring. GO TO Fairy Ring.

ev:15-the-unicorn:a-coil-rises.html: A coil rises under the raft, and lifts it clean out of the sea. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Coiled.

ev:15-the-unicorn:between-the-coils.html: You slip between the coils as they rise, and come out right beside its neck, which it wasn't expecting. The Towering Beast starts the fight with one extra life fewer. GO TO Coiled.

ev:15-the-unicorn:chipping-crystals.html: The crystals come loose with a crack, and a puff of yellow, and a faint, high squeal. Each player who succeeded gains 6 gold in crystals. Each who failed starts the coming fight with one card in their improvisation deck. The broken crystals bleed sparks, and the vent begins to click. GO TO Hot Rocks.

ev:15-the-unicorn:coiled.title: Coiled
ev:15-the-unicorn:coiled.html:
Coiled
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
Towering Beast (#6)
Outcome
Victory
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • A coil comes down on the raft, and you're shipwrecked.
  • 3 exp for each player.

If you won, the serpent sinks, coil by coil, until the sea is only the sea again. GO TO another day at sea. If you lost, GO TO Shipwrecked.

ev:15-the-unicorn:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:15-the-unicorn:deserts.html:
At noon, you reach a ruined temple half swallowed by the dunes. Its mirrors, still polished after who knows how many centuries, catch the sun and pour it onto the altar, where a disc of gold burns too bright to look at. Before it kneels something in a priest's robes. It has been kneeling for a very long time.

Choose one
  • Kneel beside it, and pray with your eyes open. Trial 9 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO the sun shows you. If you fail, GO TO the light fills your eyes.
  • Turn the mirrors away from the altar. Trial 6 BODY (Might). If you succeed, GO TO the temple goes dim. If you fail, GO TO the mirrors won't turn.
  • (+1 curse) Take the golden disc. GO TO the sun's price.
  • Wake the priest. GO TO Sunstroke.

ev:15-the-unicorn:hatched-in-your-hands.html: The first crystal you hit splits open, and what's inside bites. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Hot Rocks.

ev:15-the-unicorn:hot-rocks.title: Hot Rocks
ev:15-the-unicorn:hot-rocks.html:
The crystals split open all along the vent, spilling glowing spiderlings over the rock, and from the fumes below climbs their mother, smoking.

Hot Rocks
Crescent
Enemy
4×Emberskitter Spiderlings (#19)
Full Moon
EnemyExtra Lives
Emberskitter Matriarch (#21)
Outcome
Victory
  • 6 gold, in crystals that didn't hatch.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:hunting-the-hunters.html: They come to the net in a bunch, laughing, with their bows on their backs. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Nets and Arrows.

ev:15-the-unicorn:kicked-free.html: It kicks free of the net, and of you, and it's gone. You're still picking yourself up when the hunters come out of the trees. The party is Worn: every player starts the fight with one card in their improvisation deck. GO TO Nets and Arrows.

ev:15-the-unicorn:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:15-the-unicorn:mountains.html:
Following a smell of rotten eggs, you find a vent in the mountainside breathing yellow fumes. The rock around it is studded with crystals the colour of embers, warm to the touch, and every so often, one of them twitches.

Choose one
  • Chip a few from the edge. Everyone holds their breath and takes a Trial 5 SOUL (Resolve): GO TO chipping crystals.
  • Climb down into the vent, where the big ones are. Trial 9 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO the big ones. If you fail, GO TO the fumes close over.
  • Smash them before they hatch. Trial 6 SOUL (Might). If you succeed, GO TO smashed in the shell. If you fail, GO TO hatched in your hands.
  • Wait for whatever laid them. GO TO Hot Rocks.

ev:15-the-unicorn:nature-s-wrath.title: Nature's Wrath
ev:15-the-unicorn:nature-s-wrath.html:
The eldest raises her staff, and the forest answers. The wolves rise, and from behind the stones comes the thing that was breathing.

Nature's Wrath
Crescent
Enemy
Pack Predator (#2)
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
Towering Beast (#6)
Additional Rules
  • If you asked for the blessing, it's a test: the beasts withdraw as soon as you win or lose, and nobody dies.
Outcome
Victory
  • If you took the offerings: 20 gold, 1x random Rare Travel item and 1x random Uncommon Potion.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player, unless it was a test.
  • 3 exp for each player.

If you won the test, GO TO the druids' blessing. Otherwise, STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:nets-and-arrows.title: Nets and Arrows
ev:15-the-unicorn:nets-and-arrows.html:
The hunters spread out around the net, and nock their arrows. “That was ours,” says the one in front.

Nets and Arrows
Crescent
Enemy
Poacher (#4)
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
Ironclad Ranger (#18)
Outcome
Victory
  • Longbow (Common Weapon #6) and 6 gold.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:15-the-unicorn:oceans.html:
The swell ahead isn't a swell. It's a coil, grey-green and crusted with barnacles, rising and sinking in a long, slow wave. Then another beside it, and another, until the raft is drifting through a maze of serpent. Far ahead, a head the size of a boat turns, and looks back down its own length at you.

Choose one
  • (Everyone spends a card) Paddle hard for a gap before it closes, and meet the head in open water. GO TO through the gap.
  • Read the coils, and steer for where the gaps are going to be. Trial 8 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO between the coils. If you fail, GO TO a coil rises.
  • Draw your weapons, and wait for the head to come to you. GO TO Coiled.

ev:15-the-unicorn:plains.title: Plains
ev:15-the-unicorn:plains.html:
Near the edge of the woods, a white horse is tangled in a hunter's net, thrashing. Then it turns its head, and you see the horn on its brow, spiralled like a seashell and bright as new silver. Somewhere close, a hunting horn answers it: the hunters are coming back for their catch.

Choose one
  • Calm it, and cut it free. Trial 6 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the unicorn's thanks. If you fail, GO TO kicked free.
  • Hide in the long grass, and wait for the hunters. Trial 6 BODY (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO hunting the hunters. If you fail, GO TO spotted in the grass.
  • (+2 curse) Wait for the hunters, and sell it to them. GO TO sold to the hunters.
  • (+3 curse) Take the horn. GO TO the horn.

ev:15-the-unicorn:smashed-in-the-shell.html: You go along the rock with the pommel of your sword, and a good many of the crystals never hatch at all. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Hot Rocks.

ev:15-the-unicorn:sold-to-the-hunters.html: The hunters are delighted, and a little puzzled: the Shackled aren't usually so reasonable. They pay in full, and then their leader looks at your wrist and has an idea. The Shackled fetch a bounty too. But his men are still busy with the net. You gain 40 gold. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Nets and Arrows.

ev:15-the-unicorn:spotted-in-the-grass.html: The hunters have hunted in this grass all their lives, and they know what a hiding place looks like from the outside. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Nets and Arrows.

ev:15-the-unicorn:sunstroke.title: Sunstroke
ev:15-the-unicorn:sunstroke.html:
The priest raises its hands, and the light from the mirrors bends to it. Out of the sand around the altar climb the temple's servants, who kept the mirrors polished, and kept on keeping them.

Sunstroke
Quarter
Enemy
Raised Bones (#3)
Full Moon
EnemyExtra Lives
Mage (#32)
Additional Rules
  • The Mage's spells are Fire.
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Rare item, from the priest's robes.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-big-ones.html: You come back up coughing, with your arms full, and something comes up after you. You gain 20 gold and 1x random Rare Travel item. GO TO Hot Rocks.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-druids-blessing.html: The eldest lays a hand on your brow, and the forest seems to lean closer, and show you things. Everyone gains 2 EXP, and may look through their training deck for a card with a SOUL icon, and buy or swap it for its EXP cost. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-fence.html:
She sells what's been lost, and buys what's been found, and she doesn't much care which is which.

(+1 curse) Buy stolen goods at half their value:

ItemPrice
2x random Uncommon itemHalf the item's value
1x random Rare itemHalf the item's value

She also buys any item for half its value. STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-fighting-pit.html:
A ring of torches, a crowd of shouting gamblers, and in the middle, a man with a broken nose and a very big grin. The prize is fifteen gold.

The Pit
Quarter
Enemy
Brawler (#14)
Additional Rules
  • Only one player fights. The others watch: they don't play cards, and can't be targeted.
  • Before the fight, each of the others may bet up to 5 gold on the fighter. If the fighter wins, they win their bet back doubled.
Outcome
Victory
  • The prize: 15 gold.
  • 4 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 6 exp for each player.

After the fight, STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-forest-approves.html: The forest looks at you for a long time, and seems to like what it sees. When the test begins, it begins gently. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Nature's Wrath.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-forest-frowns.html: The fire gutters, and the wolves get up. The party is Worn: every player starts the fight with one card in their improvisation deck. GO TO Nature's Wrath.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-fumes-close-over.html: The fumes close over your head. You come out of the vent on your hands and knees, and the vent comes out after you. The party is Worn: every player starts the fight with one card in their improvisation deck. GO TO Hot Rocks.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-horn.html:
It takes a long time. The unicorn doesn't stop looking at you, not once, not even at the end. The hunters arrive just after the end, and see what you've done to their catch.

You gain 3x random Rare Potion and 20 gold. GO TO Nets and Arrows.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-light-fills-your-e.html: The light fills your eyes, and keeps filling them. Somewhere in it, the priest stands up. The fight starts Off guard: no planning in the first round, so you can only improvise. GO TO Sunstroke.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-mirrors-won-t-turn.html: The mirrors have been set for a thousand years, and mean to stay that way. You're still heaving at the last one when the priest stands up. The party is Worn: every player starts the fight with one card in their improvisation deck. GO TO Sunstroke.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-spice-stalls.html:
Saffron, pepper, dried fish, and a cheese that the stallholder warns you not to turn your back on.

ItemPrice
2x random Uncommon Food itemItem value
1x random Rare Food itemItem value

STOP READING.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-sun-s-price.html:
The disc is heavy, and hot, and worth a fortune. The priest stands up as it leaves the altar, and the sun seems to follow you, lower and hotter than it should be.

You gain 40 gold. Search the adventure deck and discard pile for Smoldering Heat, and make it the active weather. GO TO Sunstroke.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-sun-shows-you.html: For a moment, you can see everything: every grain of sand, every star behind the sky, the Shackle on your wrist, glowing like a coal, and the priest beside you, who is bones under the robe, and hasn't noticed you yet. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Sunstroke.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-temple-goes-dim.html: The mirrors grind round on their pivots, and the temple goes dim and cool. Its dead servants, who know only the light, stumble in the dark. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Sunstroke.

ev:15-the-unicorn:the-unicorn-s-thanks.html: It stands still for you, trembling, while you cut the last cord. Then it lowers its head and touches the horn to each of your brows in turn, and every ache you've carried today goes out like a candle. You're still standing there, dazed, when the hunters come out of the trees. Everyone gains 2 EXP. GO TO Nets and Arrows.

ev:15-the-unicorn:through-the-gap.html: The coils close behind you with a sound like a sigh, and you're out in open water, with room to fight, when the head comes round. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Coiled.

ev:15-the-unicorn:towns.title: Towns
ev:15-the-unicorn:towns.html:
When the sun goes down, lanterns fill the town's lower square and the night market opens: stalls that aren't there by day, run by people you'd never see by daylight.

You may choose up to two options below. Resolve them one at a time, reading each until you reach STOP READING.

Choose up to two
  • Browse the spice stalls. GO TO the spice stalls.
