  • Visit the fence, who asks no questions. GO TO the fence.
  • Step into the fighting pit. GO TO the fighting pit.

ev:15-the-unicorn:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:15-the-unicorn:woodlands.html:
The path ends at a ring of standing stones, older than the trees around them, with a fire in the middle that doesn't seem to need wood. Robed figures turn to watch you come, and the wolves lying at their feet lift their heads. Behind the stones, something much larger is breathing.

Choose one
  • Ask for the druids' blessing. “The forest blesses those it has tested,” says the eldest. Trial 6 SOUL (Resolve), to stand still while it looks at you. If you succeed, GO TO the forest approves. If you fail, GO TO the forest frowns.
  • (+1 curse) Take the offerings heaped at the foot of the stones. GO TO Nature's Wrath.

ev:16-the-thing-merchant:open-for-busine.html:
Win or lose, the jackals have had enough of you, and slink off into the grass. The creature slides down the drainpipe, takes an excited hop, and bows deeply. "Customers do like things, I hear. Please help yourself to some gold so you may purchase a thing."

Choose one
  • Turn around and leave. I want absolutely nothing to do with this. GO TO Leave the shop.
  • (+10 gold). Take the gold and leave. Hey, free gold! GO TO Take the gold.
  • (+10 gold). Take the gold and enter the store. GO TO Enter the shop.

ev:16-the-thing-merchant:plains.title: Plains
ev:16-the-thing-merchant:plains.html:
A stone building stands alone on the plain: a shop, in surprisingly good repair, under a sign in elaborate cursive that simply reads "Things". Beside it, a copper bowl on a stone pillar brims with gold coins. A pack of jackals circles the shop, snapping at a creature on its roof: a thing of pure black, flat as a tall man's shadow held upright, hopping from foot to foot along the ridge.

It sees you and waves both arms. "Customers, at last! Would you be so kind as to remove the other customers? They don't buy anything."

Choose one
  • Drive off the jackals. GO TO Bad for Business.
  • Leave it to its problem. STOP READING.

ev:2:a-bribe-for-the-admiralty.html: The officer weighs the purses, finds that your contraband has become remarkably hard to see, and turns his back. His sergeant, who wasn't offered a share, doesn't. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Repel Boarders.

ev:2:a-plague-of-frogs.title: A Plague of Frogs
ev:2:a-plague-of-frogs.html:
The frogs regard you with the calm of creatures accustomed to teleporting out of trouble.

A Plague of Frogs
Quarter
Enemy
4×Warpfrog (#25)
Additional Rules
  • If you succeeded the Lore trial and kept still, the Warpfrogs start in Full Moon instead.
Outcome
Victory
  • If you carry the Magister's jar, a frog hops into it: you have a frog in a jar.
  • 2x random Common Food item, from the grateful farmer.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:2:chapter-and-verse.html: The officer sends for the charter, and reads the clause twice while his marines lean on the rail to listen. By the time he looks up, you're over it. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Repel Boarders.

ev:2:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:2:deserts.html:
Riders crest the dune on pale horses, scarves over their faces and swords already drawn. They don't bother shouting demands. Out here, nobody would hear them.

Choose one
  • (Everyone sets aside half their gold, rounded up) Toss them your purses. GO TO still counting.
  • Draw your weapons. GO TO Sand and Deliver.

ev:2:keep-very-still.html: Something stirs in your memory: these frogs strike at whatever moves. You keep very still. GO TO A Plague of Frogs.

ev:2:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:2:mountains.html:
The mine's timbers are black with soot, and so is the snow in front of it. A fire bucket hangs by the entrance, full of meltwater. As you pass, the darkness inside the shaft grins at you. It has a great many teeth.

Choose one
  • Grab the bucket, and douse the darkness. GO TO Where There's Smoke.
  • Stand your ground. GO TO Where There's Smoke.

ev:2:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:2:oceans.html:
A cutter flying the royal colours runs down on your raft, and an officer in a plumed helmet leans over the rail. “By order of the Admiralty, the Shackled are barred from these waters. You'll be towed ashore, and your contraband confiscated.” He looks over your belongings. All of them, it seems, are contraband.

Choose one
  • (Everyone loses 2 gold) Bribe the officer. GO TO a bribe for the Admiralty.
  • Quote him the Admiralty's own charter, which bars the Shackled from its harbours, not from the open sea. Trial 5 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO chapter and verse. If you fail, GO TO the charter, amended.
  • Refuse. GO TO Repel Boarders.

ev:2:pale-figures-rise.html:
You watch in horror as several pale figures rise around you, eyes alight with the dark embers of undeath. As their skeletal bodies take shape, they waste no time readying their rusted weapons.

Choose one
  • (Spend a SOUL card). Cast a prayer to Adrai'lalth, goddess of light and healing. Trial 4 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO successful prayer. If you fail, GO TO failed prayer.

  • Charge at the undead. GO TO Pale Ambush.

ev:2:plains.title: Plains
ev:2:plains.html:
A farmer waves you down from a field crawling with frogs. They cover every furrow, and every few heartbeats one of them vanishes with a soft pop and reappears somewhere worse: in the well, in the bread oven, on the farmer's head.

“The wizard's,” she says, pointing at a tower on the horizon. “He said they'd find their own way home.” Before you can answer, a frog pops into being on your shoulder, and a dozen more on your boots. It seems they have found you instead.

Trial 4 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO keep very still. If you fail, GO TO A Plague of Frogs.

ev:2:repel-boarders.title: Repel Boarders
ev:2:repel-boarders.html:
The officer sighs, as if you'd spilled something on his deck, and waves his marines over the rail.

Repel Boarders
Quarter
Enemy
Royal Guard (#24)
Additional Rules
  • When every Royal Guard is defeated, the cutter gives up and sails away.
Outcome
Victory
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • Each player loses an item of common or uncommon rarity.
  • 3 exp for each player.

If you won, GO TO another day at sea. If you lost, the cutter tows you to the nearest shore, and cuts you loose in the surf: move to the nearest land location. GO TO successful landing.

ev:2:sanctuary.html:
You outrun the mob through three alleys and a laundry, and burst through the first door that's open: the goddess's shrine. The old priestess bars it behind you, looks at the Shackle, and decides that a fugitive is a fugitive.

You may rest sheltered here now, at the cost of 2 gold. STOP READING.

ev:2:sand-and-deliver.title: Sand and Deliver
ev:2:sand-and-deliver.html:
Your attackers fan out to surround you, grinning. They've done this before, and it's never once gone badly for them.

Sand and Deliver
Quarter
Enemy
4×Bandit (#1)
Additional Rules
  • If you tossed them your purses, the Bandits start in Full Moon instead, still counting.
Outcome
Victory
  • 6 gold, and take back any gold you set aside.
  • 1x random Common Weapon.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • Any gold you set aside is gone. If you set none aside, everyone loses half their gold, rounded up.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:2:still-counting.html: The leader tosses your purses to a rider, who starts counting. The swords stay drawn. They mean to take the rest from wherever you fall, so you don't wait for the count to finish: you strike first. GO TO Sand and Deliver.

ev:2:swept-along.html:
The mob catches you, and to your surprise, it cheers. Someone puts a mug in your hand, someone else an arm round your shoulders, and the night goes on without you for some time. You wake at dawn in a horse trough, lighter in the purse and heavier in the head.

Everyone loses 2 gold. Discard the top 2 cards of the adventure deck. STOP READING.

ev:2:the-charter-amended.html: “Amended last spring,” the officer says, and taps a fresh line of ink. His marines are already coming over the rail. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Repel Boarders.

ev:2:the-man-they-re-after.html:
You drop into the dark, pull the hatch shut, and land on someone. By the ledger he's clutching, he's the tax collector, and by the shouting overhead, he's the one the mob is looking for. He presses a purse into your hands, and a finger to his lips.

You gain 6 gold. STOP READING.

ev:2:towns.title: Towns
ev:2:towns.html:
A drunken mob rolls into the street, kicking down anything that stands upright. You have no way to tell if their mood is fueled by revelry or hatred, but it's doubtlessly a violent one, and it's heading straight at you.

Choose one
  • Stand your ground. GO TO Drunken Fight.
  • Run for it. Trial 4 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, GO TO sanctuary. If you fail, GO TO swept along.
  • Drop through the nearest cellar hatch. Trial 4 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO the man they're after. If you fail, GO TO swept along.

ev:2:where-there-s-smoke.title: Where There's Smoke
ev:2:where-there-s-smoke.html:
The soot billows out at you like smoke from a doused fire, and like smoke, it gets into everything: your eyes, your throat, the gaps in your armor. Then it starts to bite.

Where There's Smoke
Quarter
Enemy
4×Soot Biter (#5)
Additional Rules
  • If you doused them, two Soot Biters start frozen, and the other two enraged.
Outcome
Victory
  • 6 gold, glinting in the soot they leave behind.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:2:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:2:woodlands.html: Mist pools between the trees, and the birds fall silent all at once. Under the moss at your feet, something stirs. GO TO pale figures rise.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:a-cry-behind-y.html: You're barely past the fire when the traveler cries out behind you. The meal has drawn company, and the traveler has nothing to hold it off with but a stick from the embers. GO TO Stranger Danger.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:a-game-in-the-.html: The leader grins under the veil, and scratches a ring in the sand with a camel stick. Strangers who share the nomads' road share their game first: two teams, bare hands, and the losers fetch the water. GO TO Kicking Up Sand.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:a-harmless-ped.html:
The traveler throws both hands up before you've finished drawing. Under the cowl is an old peddler, who empties a pack onto the ground and backs away from it, trembling.

You gain 8 gold, 2x random Common item and 1x random Uncommon Travel item.

The peddler bolts into the grass, and the grass shivers and closes behind them. Something out there has been waiting for the fire to go out. GO TO Stranger Danger.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:a-knight-to-re.title: A Knight to Remember
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:a-knight-to-re.html:
The traveler stands, and wool slides off mail: a knight, travelling plain to avoid exactly this kind of trouble. She draws her sword with a tired sigh, and her squire comes pelting down the hill from his firewood, dragging a shield bigger than he is.

A Knight to Remember
Quarter
Enemy
Ironclad Protector (#17)
Full Moon
Enemy
Ironclad Soldier (#16)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Uncommon Armor, 1x random Uncommon Weapon and 8 gold.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:bad-water.title: Bad Water
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:bad-water.html:
The nomads don't seem surprised. They've met the Shackled before. Their riders wheel their camels round, drawing curved swords, while the women and children lead the string away across the sand.

Bad Water
Quarter
Enemy
4×Bandit (#1)
Outcome
Victory
  • Sand Nomad Robes (Uncommon Travel #1), 2x random Common Food item, 1x random Uncommon Travel item and 15 gold, from the camels they left behind.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:barter.html:
The traveler unrolls a blanket of odds and ends, and shakes their head when you reach for your purse. “Coin's no use out here. Goods for goods.”

ItemPrice
3x random Common itemAn item of at least its value
1x random Uncommon Travel itemAn item of at least its value

Once you're done trading, GO TO Plains, then choose a different option.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:between-the-be.html: Left, right, a pause where the beam crosses. You step in on the pause. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Swing Shift.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:clapped-in-iro.html: You're halfway to the benches when the manacles snap shut around your wrist, right beside the Shackle. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Rough Trade.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:deserts.html:
A string of camels comes out of the heat haze, bells ringing. The water nomads walk beside them, veiled against the sand. Their leader raises an open hand: out here, a greeting is a promise not to steal each other's water.

Choose one
  • Return the greeting. GO TO a game in the sand.
  • (+1 curse) Return the greeting, then reach for your weapons. GO TO Bad Water.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:forget-me-not.title: Forget Me Not
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:forget-me-not.html:
As you step away from the little door, the undergrowth bristles. Lean, mossy shapes slink out between the beeches and circle you. You wonder whether you've seen them before, but the memory is shaky, like a word on the tip of your tongue.

Forget Me Not
Quarter
Enemy
Pack Predator (#2)
Additional Rules
  • +1 Pack Predator if you bought anything at the memory shop.
Outcome
Victory
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:grappling-hook.html: You've gone barely a length when the hooks bite into your raft, and the galley's crew haul you back in, hand over hand. GO TO Rough Trade.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:grave-robbery.title: Grave Robbery
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:grave-robbery.html:
The traveler rises, unhurried, and the cowl falls back on a skull with two cold embers for eyes. It was never travelling alone: its company rises with it, rusted blades in bony hands. The dead are on the road to the goddess, and they don't take kindly to delays.

Grave Robbery
Crescent
Enemy
Raised Bones (#3)
Quarter
Enemy
Raised Commander (#10)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Rare Armor, from the Commander's bones, and 10 gold.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:hex-marks-the-.title: Hex Marks the Spot
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:hex-marks-the-.html:
The traveler doesn't reach for a weapon. They sigh and push back the cowl: an orc woman, older than you expected, with a string of tiny bottles clinking at her throat. She whistles once. Something in the dark whistles back.

Hex Marks the Spot
Crescent
Enemy
Pack Predator (#2)
Full Moon
Enemy
Witch (#26)
Outcome
Victory
  • 2x random Common Potion and 1x random Uncommon Potion, from her necklace.
  • 1x random Uncommon Travel item.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:kicking-up-san.title: Kicking Up Sand
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:kicking-up-san.html:
The nomads hand their swords to the children, roll up their sleeves, and wade into the ring, laughing.

Kicking Up Sand
Quarter
Enemy
4×Bandit (#1)
Additional Rules
  • No weapons: players can't use their Weapon items.
  • Improvisations only: skip the planning phase every round.
Outcome
Victory
  • 2x random Common Food item: the nomads fetch the water, and share their dates.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • You fetch the water. Nobody gets hurt.
  • 3 exp for each player.

Win or lose, the nomads slap the sand off your backs like old friends. GO TO the nomads' wares.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:knock-twice.html: The big door opens. Behind it stands a very large, very old dwarf in a leather apron, holding a hammer the size of a pony. He looks at you for a long moment. Then he closes the door. On either side of you, the pendulums begin to swing, and this time nobody is holding the lever. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Swing Shift.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:mountains.html:
Around a bend in the path, a door is set into the mountainside: iron-bound, three times your height, with a much smaller door cut into it at dwarf height. In an alcove on either side hangs a great brass pendulum, perfectly still. A brass plate reads, in six languages: TRADE ENTRANCE. KNOCK ONCE. DO NOT KNOCK TWICE.

Choose one
  • Knock once. GO TO the trade entrance.
  • Knock twice. GO TO knock twice.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:oceans.html:
A fat merchant galley drifts alongside, oars shipped, and its purser leans over the rail with a ledger. “Water, biscuit, rope, charts. Everything a raft could want. Prices are what they are: you're a long way from the nearest market.”

ItemPrice
2x random Common Food itemTwice the item's value
Compass (Common Travel #3)6 gold
Navigation Charts (Rare Travel #1)30 gold

While you haggle, the galley's master comes to the rail. He looks for a long time at the Shackle on your wrist, then at his rowing benches, where a good many places stand empty. Oarsmen who never tire, and never die.

Once you're done trading:

Choose one
  • Offer to work your passage at the oars, and watch his hands while you do. Trial 5 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO the irons in his sleeve. If you fail, GO TO clapped in irons.
  • Push off, and sail on. GO TO grappling hooks.
  • (+1 curse) Climb aboard first, and take what you need without paying. GO TO over the rail.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:out-of-step.html: You step in on what you thought was the pause. It wasn't. Your hair is still standing on end when the next swing comes. The party is Worn: every player starts the fight with one card in their improvisation deck. GO TO Swing Shift.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:over-the-rail.html: You're over the rail before the purser has finished his sums, and into his strongroom before the master has finished shouting. GO TO Rough Trade.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:plains.title: Plains
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:plains.html:
A lone traveler camps at the edge of the road beside the remains of a meager meal, stoking smoldering embers. Their features lie concealed under a heavy cowl.

Choose one
  • Nod at the stranger and continue on your way. GO TO a cry behind you.
  • Offer to barter. GO TO barter.
  • Ask about nearby interesting locations. GO TO the traveler's map.
  • Ask about recent news. GO TO the traveler's news.

  • (+1 curse) Shouldn't have camped alone. Pull out your weapons. GO TO rob the traveler.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:push-past-the-.html: The dwarf is quicker than you expected, and louder. Before you've reached the first rack, a bell is clanging somewhere in the mountain, and doors are banging open all the way down the hall. GO TO Smash and Grab.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:rob-the-travel.html:
The traveler watches you draw steel, and doesn't move. Under the cowl, something makes up its mind.

Roll the die and add 4. If 1, GO TO Grave Robbery. If 2-3, GO TO Hex Marks the Spot. If 4, GO TO A Knight to Remember. If 5-6, GO TO Fair Game. If 7-8, GO TO a harmless peddler.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:rough-trade.title: Rough Trade
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:rough-trade.html:
The galley's crew, it turns out, are sailors who've been to a few ports rougher than you.

Rough Trade
Quarter
Enemy
Bandit (#1)
Full Moon
Enemy
Ironclad Ranger (#18)
Outcome
Victory
  • 2x random Common Food item and 4 gold, from the purser's stores.
  • If you went aboard to rob them: Compass (Common Travel #3) and Navigation Charts (Rare Travel #1) as well.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

If you won, the galley rows off in a hurry, a few more oarsmen short. GO TO another day at sea. If you lost, you spend a day chained to an oar before the master decides the Shackled are more trouble than they're worth, and throws you off at the nearest shore: move to the nearest land location. GO TO successful landing.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:smash-and-grab.title: Smash and Grab
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:smash-and-grab.html:
Mailed dwarves with axes close in around you, and none of them are smiling.

Smash and Grab
Quarter
Enemy
Ironclad Protector (#17)
Full Moon
Enemy
Ironclad Soldier (#16)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Rare Weapon and 1x random Rare Armor, and 10 gold from the till.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:stranger-dange.title: Stranger Danger
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:stranger-dange.html:
Lean shapes slink out of the grass, drawn by the smell of the meal, and they don't much mind who they share it with.

Stranger Danger
Quarter
Enemy
Pack Predator (#2)
Full Moon
Enemy
Civilian (#35)
Additional Rules
  • The Civilian is the traveler, on your side: it never attacks, and the Pack Predators can target it.
  • You win when every Pack Predator is dead. If the Civilian dies, you lose.
  • If you robbed the traveler, leave out the Civilian: the traveler is long gone.
Outcome
Victory
  • If you saved the traveler, 1x random Common Travel item, from the traveler's pack.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:swing-shift.title: Swing Shift
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:swing-shift.html:
The wardens swing across the doorway, left and right, humming, and the air between them tastes of copper.

Swing Shift
Quarter
Enemy
Arc Sentry (#8)
Additional Rules
  • If you knocked once, it's a spar: the dwarves stop the wardens as soon as you win or lose.
Outcome
Victory
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player, unless it was a spar.
  • 3 exp for each player.

If you knocked once, GO TO the forge's racks. If you knocked twice and won, the old dwarf opens the big door again, looks at what's left of his wardens, and sighs. GO TO the forge's racks. If you knocked twice and lost, STOP READING.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:the-forge-s-ra.html:
Behind the little door, racks of steel climb into the dark, every blade stamped with the same rune. If you lost the spar, every price is 2 gold more, for the wardens' trouble.

  • Trade, and go on your way. STOP READING.
  • (+1 curse) Push past the dwarf, and help yourselves. GO TO push past the dwarf.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:the-irons-in-h.html: His hand comes out of his sleeve with a pair of manacles in it, and finds your blade waiting. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Rough Trade.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:the-memory-sho.html:
Each memory you sell leaves a small, clean hole behind: the name of a childhood friend, the taste of your mother's bread, what you were doing yesterday morning.

ItemPrice

1x random Rare Travel item2 cards in your improvisation deck for the coming fight

Once you're done trading, GO TO Forget Me Not.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:the-trade-entr.html:
The dwarf who answers looks you over, sniffs at the Shackle as if it were a bad smell, then jerks a thumb at the pendulums. “Customers spar with the wardens first. Old custom. Keeps out the riff-raff.” Somewhere inside, a lever clanks, and the brass begins to swing, and to crackle.

Choose one
  • Watch the swing before you step in. Trial 4 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO between the beats. If you fail, GO TO out of step.
  • Step in. GO TO Swing Shift.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:the-traveler-s.html:
The traveler draws a map in the ashes with a stick, then taps one spot, twice. “Now there's a place worth the walk.”

Everyone gains 1 EXP, and you hear rumours of one special location on this landmass: turn to its page, and read only its rumour section. GO TO Plains, then choose a different option.

“News?” The traveler laughs, low and hoarse, and pokes at the embers. “I've just come down the road you're about to take. That's the only news worth having.” Which bridge is out, which stretch to clear before dark, which inn waters its ale: the traveler knows it all.

Look at the top 2 cards of the adventure deck and return them to the top in any order. GO TO Plains, then choose a different option.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:towns.title: Towns
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:towns.html:
You find yourself wandering around town long after sunset. There's little going on; the few humble stores have closed and most folk have shuttered their windows for the night. This makes it all the more surprising when a girl of no more than ten approaches you with a fearless skip.

"Look at what I found!" she says, proudly holding up what you quickly recognize as an object of great value. Place a random rare Travel item on the table. This is the item held by the child.

Choose one
  • Grab the item from the child's hand. "Fantastic! I've been looking for that". GO TO stole from the unid kid.
  • Ask the child to return it. "That probably belongs to someone. You should hand it over to the garrison." GO TO asked the unid kid to return.
  • Offer the whole item's value in gold, or an item of at least its value. "I could use that. How about we barter?" GO TO fair offer to unid kid.
  • Offer half (rounded up) of the item's value in gold, or an item of at least half (rounded up) its value. "Are you sure you'd not rather have this? Look, it's shiny!" GO TO unfair offer to unid kid.

ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:3-traveler-greed-eater:woodlands.html:
Beside the path, a little door is set into the roots of a beech tree, painted blue, with a sign: OPEN (FOR NOW). Behind it, a ferret you can see straight through sits at a counter made from a mushroom cap, selling things far too large to have fit through the door.

“Gold?” it says, wrinkling its nose. “How vulgar. I take memories.”

Choose one
  • Shop. GO TO the memory shop.
  • Back away slowly. GO TO Forget Me Not.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html: Something much bigger roars back, from much closer than you thought. They're on you before the echo dies. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Tooth and Claw.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: A Warm Welcome
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html:
Spiders the size of your fist pour out of the dunes, each one glowing like a coal from the forge. Somewhere under the sand, something round and pulsing keeps making more.

A Warm Welcome
Quarter
Enemy
4×Emberskitter Spiderlings (#19)
Full Moon
Enemy
Emberskitter Sack (#20)
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Common Travel item, from the bones of the last traveler.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

You crash into the thorns and turn. The pack strung itself out in the chase, and the first of them runs straight onto your blade. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Tooth and Claw.

You hear the faint friction of steel against steel. A group of half a dozen armored men, perhaps more, hide in disciplined silence by the side of the road.

Their stillness tells you these are no ordinary bandits.

Choose one
  • Sneak around the bandits to ambush them. GO TO ambush the bandits.
  • Charge at the bandits. GO TO charge.

A sound you can't place tugs at the edge of your concentration. You turn your head, listening intently, but can't hear anything of the sort after a minute of intense focus. You shrug and continue moving.

A minute later, you bitterly realize your mistake. This time it's not one sound but many; the unmistakable swish of several swords leaving their scabbards.

GO TO Moonlit Ambush
The overhang comes down with a sound like the end of the world, and when the white settles, fewer shapes climb out of it. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Tooth and Claw.
The sand gives way under your boots, and the glow closes in all around you. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO A Warm Welcome.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: Deserts
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html:
The sand stays warm long after sunset. Then it gets warmer. Then, all around you, it begins to glow, and to click, and to move.

Choose one
  • Run for the rocks, and make them climb to you. Trial 5 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, GO TO up on the rocks. If you fail, GO TO caught on the sand.
  • Find the pulsing thing under the sand before it makes more. Trial 5 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO the nest found. If you fail, GO TO the nest stirred.
  • Stand and fight. GO TO A Warm Welcome.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: Mountains
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html:
The snow in the pass is churned with tracks, large and small, all heading the same way you are. Winter has driven the predators down from the peaks. Ahead, something howls, and something bigger answers.

Choose one
  • Stare them down as they come. Trial 6 SOUL (Might). If you succeed, GO TO they hesitate. If you fail, GO TO they smell fear.
  • Bring the overhang down on the pass ahead of them. Trial 5 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO buried in the pass. If you fail, GO TO the slope gives way.
  • Draw your weapons. GO TO Tooth and Claw.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: Oceans
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html: For once, the sea is empty in every direction, which is exactly how you like it. It doesn't last. GO TO pirates.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: Plains
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html:
You travel at night, keeping a safe distance from the main roads. The silence is only broken by the rustling of grass and the chirp of an army of crickets, cicadas, the occasional toad, and countless other nightly critters.

Trial 4 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO bandits spotted. If you fail, GO TO bandits undetected.
She points at the door, and the farmer helpfully holds it open for you. STOP READING.
Half the pack falls on the food, snapping at each other. The rest come at you alone. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Tooth and Claw.

The shopkeeper's son takes your coin as readily as anyone's, and rather more of it.

ItemPrice
4x random Common itemItem value + 2 gold
2x random Uncommon itemItem value + 2 gold

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.

She sighs, and serves you with the very tips of her fingers.

ItemPrice
6x random Common itemItem value
3x random Uncommon itemItem value

Once you're done trading, STOP READING.
You drive your blade into the sand where it beats hardest, and a whole clutch dies before it hatches. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO A Warm Welcome.
You dig in the wrong place, and the sand boils with newly hatched spiders. The fight is Reinforced: one enemy more in each group. GO TO A Warm Welcome.

Your roar shakes the leaves. The younger ones flatten their ears and slink back into the dark, and only the bold ones come on. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Tooth and Claw.

The snow comes down, but not where you meant. You dig yourselves out, half frozen, to find the pack waiting. The party is Worn: every player starts the fight with one card in their improvisation deck. GO TO Tooth and Claw.

The pack stops at the edge of the drift, waiting for its leader to go first. You don't give it the chance. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Tooth and Claw.
Your stare wavers for a heartbeat, and a heartbeat is all they need. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Tooth and Claw.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: Towns
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html:
You find the general store on the main street. A bell rings as you step in. The shopkeeper looks up, looks at you, and turns the sign in the window to CLOSED without a word. When a farmer comes in behind you, she turns it back.

Choose one
  • Remind her that the Shackle isn't catching. Trial 5 MIND (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the general store. If you fail, GO TO shown the door.
  • Go round the back, where her son sells what she won't. GO TO the back door.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

You reach the rocks with your boots smoking, and the glow comes up after you in a ragged, scrabbling line. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO A Warm Welcome.

They run you down long before the thicket, and you turn to face them with your lungs on fire. The party is Worn: every player starts the fight with one card in their improvisation deck. GO TO Tooth and Claw.

ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.title: Woodlands
ev:4-horses-woodland-chest-promontory-ta.html:
A low, rumbling growl disrupts the quietude of the forest. Bright, fierce pairs of eyes track you from behind the dimly lit underbrush. The hairs on the back of your neck stand up, leaving you with little doubt about the intent of these creatures.

Choose one
  • (Lose a Food item) Toss your food into the brush, and let them squabble over it. GO TO squabbling over scraps.
  • Run for the thicket, where they can only come at you one by one. Trial 5 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, GO TO backs to the thicket. If you fail, GO TO winded.
  • Stand tall and let out a roar. Trial 6 SOUL (Might). If you succeed, GO TO the pack wavers. If you fail, GO TO a challenge answered.
  • Raise your weapon and charge towards the source of the noise. GO TO Tooth and Claw.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:a-golden-glin.html:
The evening sunlight plays tricks on the corner of your eye as it filters through the forest canopy, so you nearly miss a brief golden glint at the edge of your vision. You turn and stand still, squinting to find the shiny object against the backdrop of shifting leaves.

Trial 1 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO shiny object. If you fail, continue reading.

You spend a minute scanning your surroundings, but find nothing. You ascribe the glint to a trick of the evening light, and continue on your way. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:a-handful-of-.html: You're at the cave mouth, pockets heavy, when the hoard shifts behind you. Out here, in the wind and the snow, its fire gutters. You gain 8 gold. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Old Fire.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:caught-in-a-s.html: A noose snaps tight around your ankle and hauls you off your feet. You cut yourself down to the sound of laughter. The fight starts Off guard: no planning in the first round, so you can only improvise. GO TO Snares and Bolts.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:circle-the-wa.title: Circle the Wagons
ev:5-offering-curio-market:circle-the-wa.html:
The bandits kick over their stew and grab whatever's closest. The chief doesn't even get up. He just picks another knife.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:deaf-to-the-s.html: The song beats against the wax like moths at a window. The singers watch you row in, and can't understand why you aren't smiling. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Siren Song.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:5-offering-curio-market:deserts.html:
Jackals have dogged you since noon, never closer than a stone's throw. Then the wind uncovers the tip of a black pyramid, a doorway gaping just below the sand, and the jackals stop dead at the edge of its shadow, and whine.

Choose one
  • Turn on the jackals. GO TO at the edge of the shadow.
  • Go down into the pyramid, where they won't follow. GO TO the pyramid's stair.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:inside-their-.html: You're among them before the first string twangs, and one of them drops his crossbow and bolts into the woods. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Snares and Bolts.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:keeping-the-t.html: You load up what you can carry, and drink a toast to the bandits with their own wine. You gain 15 gold, 1x random Rare Food item (the best of the wine) and 1x random Uncommon Travel item. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:5-offering-curio-market:mountains.html:
Smoke curls from a cave high on the slope, in long, slow breaths. Inside, on a hill of gold, sleeps a great fire salamander, longer than a river barge. It's old, and the fire along its back burns low.

Choose one
  • Take a handful, and get out before it wakes. Trial 5 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO a handful of gold. If you fail, GO TO the salamander stirs.
  • Pack snow onto its embers while it sleeps. Trial 5 BODY (Might). If you succeed, GO TO smothered embers. If you fail, GO TO the salamander stirs.
  • Strike while it sleeps. GO TO Old Fire.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:mummy-dearest.title: Mummy Dearest
ev:5-offering-curio-market:mummy-dearest.html:
All around the chamber, the painted servants step down off the walls to defend their queen.

Mummy Dearest
Crescent

  • The grave goods, if you haven't taken them: 6 gold and 1x random Uncommon Travel item.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:5-offering-curio-market:oceans.html:
A song drifts across the water, sweeter than anything you've ever heard, and your hands have turned the rudder towards it before you've decided to. Ahead, pale shapes are singing on a black reef. The rocks around them are white with bones, and some of the bones are still moving.

Choose one
  • (Everyone spends a card) Stop your ears with wax and rag, and row in deaf. GO TO deaf to the song.
  • Steer by the stars instead of the song, and make them come to you. Trial 6 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO steering clear. If you fail, GO TO the sirens' reef.
  • Let the song bring you in, blades ready. GO TO Siren Song.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:one-of-the-ga.html: The chief looks you up and down, and laughs. “Shackled! Can't die, can't be hanged. You'll do.” You drink with them and sing their songs, and at dawn you ride out with them to meet a caravan. The chief puts you at the front: whoever can't die goes in first. +1 curse.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:plains.title: Plains
ev:5-offering-curio-market:plains.html:
A ring of wagons crowns the hill, stolen from half the caravans on the road and chained together into a fort. Inside, around the biggest fire you've seen in weeks, bandits are counting the takings. Their chief throws knives at a merchant painted on a barrel while he waits.

Choose one
  • Walk in and ask to join. “I hear the pay's excellent.” Trial 6 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO one of the gang. If you fail, GO TO Circle the Wagons.
  • Slip in after dark, and cut the merchant loose before the fighting starts. Trial 5 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO the merchant freed. If you fail, GO TO the chief's eye.
  • Attack the camp. GO TO Circle the Wagons.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:returning-the.html: You leave the wagons where they stand. The villagers will come for what's theirs, and when they do, they'll be telling stories about you instead of the bandits. Everyone gains 1 EXP. STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:siren-song.title: Siren Song
ev:5-offering-curio-market:siren-song.html:
The bones on the rocks stand up, in the rags of a dozen drowned crews, and wade out to meet you. The song never stops.

Siren Song
Quarter
Enemy

Full Moon
Enemy

Additional Rules
  • The Witch is the song. When it dies, the Raised Bones fall still, and you win.
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Common item, from the bones on the reef.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • The reef keeps your raft, and you're shipwrecked.
  • 3 exp for each player.

If you won, you push off the reef, and it's a long time before you stop hearing the song. GO TO another day at sea. If you lost, GO TO Shipwrecked.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:smothered-emb.html: The snow hisses into steam, and the fire along its back dies to a red glow. It wakes slow and half blind. The Towering Beast starts the fight with 1 extra life fewer. GO TO Old Fire.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:steering-clea.html: You hold your course off the reef, and the singers have to come out through the surf after you. Not all of them care to. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Siren Song.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-chief-s-e.html: The chief's next knife thuds into the barrel a finger from your hand. He's been watching you since you left the trees. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Circle the Wagons.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-first-vol.html: The bolts hit before you've covered half the ground. The party is Worn: every player starts the fight with one card in their improvisation deck. GO TO Snares and Bolts.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-front-of-.title: The Front of the Line
ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-front-of-.html:
The bandits whoop and fall on the wagons behind you, and you meet the caravan's guards with the whole gang at your back.

The Front of the Line
Quarter
Enemy
Ironclad Soldier (#16)
Full Moon
Enemy
Ironclad Protector (#17)
Additional Rules
  • The bandits keep the rest of the guards busy, and stay out of the fight.
Outcome
Victory
  • Your share: 15 gold and 1x random Rare Weapon.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-grave-goo.html: You fill your packs under the queen's stone stare. She doesn't blink. Then the lid of her sarcophagus begins to grind aside. You gain 6 gold and 1x random Uncommon Travel item. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Mummy Dearest.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-lid-grind.html: You heave the lid aside, and your blades are already falling as the queen sits up in a shower of dust and linen. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Mummy Dearest.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-merchant-.html: You cut his ropes in the dark. He presses a purse into your hand and runs for it, shouting the alarm in exactly the wrong direction, and half the camp goes charging off after him. You gain 4 gold. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Circle the Wagons.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-pyramid-s.html:
The stair is trapped, as stairs into pyramids always are. The trick is to use only the steps the last thief didn't.

Everyone takes a Trial 3 BODY (Athletics). Each player who fails puts one of their cards in their improvisation deck for the coming fight.

At the bottom lies a burial chamber: painted walls, jars of oil long gone to dust, and grave goods heaped around a sarcophagus carved in the likeness of a queen. Her stone eyes are open.

Choose one
  • Fill your packs with the grave goods. GO TO the grave goods.
  • Open the sarcophagus, and strike before she rises. GO TO the lid grinds aside.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-salamande.html: A coin slides down the hoard with a sound like a bell in an empty church. One golden eye opens, and the cave fills with heat. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Old Fire.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-sirens-re.html: The raft grinds onto the reef, and the singers crowd closer, still smiling, still singing. Their teeth are very long. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Siren Song.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:the-takings.html:
The wagons are stuffed with everything the road has lost this year: bolts of cloth, casks of wine, a harp, a coffin full of spoons.

Choose one
  • Keep it. GO TO keeping the takings.
  • Leave it for the villagers to recover. GO TO returning the takings.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:through-the-s.html: You weave between the wires as they hunt for you, and come out of the brush beside them. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Snares and Bolts.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:towns.title: Towns
ev:5-offering-curio-market:towns.html:
The street broadens into a crowded market avenue, abuzz with calls to taste local delicacies, try on the finest—and somehow also cheapest—silks, and engage in a myriad games of skill and chance. You have to stand on your toes to plot your way through the dense crowd. If you don't want to waste the entire day here, you'll have to be deliberate about which business you wade your way towards.

You may choose up to three options from the list below. Resolve them sequentially, reading each of them until you reach the "STOP READING" line.

Choose up to three
  • Make your way to the food stalls. GO TO food shop.
  • Enter the travel equipment store. GO TO travel shop.
  • Check out the weaponsmith's workshop. GO TO weapon shop.
  • Visit the armory. GO TO armory.
  • Visit the alchemist's shop. GO TO potion shop.
  • Enter the pawn shop to rid yourself of some excess weight. GO TO pawn shop.
  • Look around the side streets for unmarked, interesting stores. GO TO interesting stores.
  • Try your luck at a game of chance. GO TO game of chance.

ev:5-offering-curio-market:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:5-offering-curio-market:woodlands.html:
Snares hang from every second branch, and a line of fresh boot prints runs between them. A whistle, a rustle, and four poachers step out from the trees, crossbows raised. To them, the Shackle on your wrist looks a lot like a bounty.

Choose one
  • Slip between their snares, and come at them from the side. Trial 4 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO through the snares. If you fail, GO TO caught in a snare.
  • Rush them before they can loose. Trial 5 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, GO TO inside their aim. If you fail, GO TO the first volley.
  • Charge. GO TO Snares and Bolts.

ev:6-the-last-customer:a-cracking-branch.html: A branch cracks underfoot. Every head turns towards you, and the bear is the first to move. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO The Bear Necessities.

ev:6-the-last-customer:a-faltering-step.html: Your step falters halfway across, the bridge sways, and every skull turns to follow it. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO The Old Toll.

ev:6-the-last-customer:counting-the-toll.html: The coins ring on the heap. Half the guards stoop to count them, joint by clicking joint. The rest decide it isn't enough. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO The Old Toll.

ev:6-the-last-customer:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:6-the-last-customer:deserts.html:
A brass bell rings somewhere beneath your feet. You stop. It rings again, followed by a muffled voice.

“A moment, please. I seem to have misplaced the door.”

Brushing sand from the slope reveals the top of a wooden stall, buried almost to its counter. Behind it, a little clay man strains to lift a shutter, and rows of dusty jars line the back shelf, their lids domed and straining. His painted moustache has mostly flaked away, and one ear has been replaced with a drawer handle.

“One customer left,” he says. “Then I may close.” He nods towards a skeleton slumped against the counter, its fingers still curled around a coin. “A patient gentleman. I should hate to disappoint him.”

Choose one
  • Offer to free the shutter. “Perhaps we can finish his shopping for him.” GO TO free the buried shutter.
  • (+1 curse) Knock the little clay man off his stool, and empty his till. GO TO the till.
  • Wrench the shutter up by force. GO TO the shutter wrenched.

ev:6-the-last-customer:fingers-on-the-li.html: You spot the bony fingers hooked over the lids, and you're ready with an oar when the first of them lifts. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO Dead Reckoning.

ev:6-the-last-customer:laid-to-rest.html: The words come to you as if someone had been waiting to hear them. The knocking stops in coffin after coffin, and they sink, one by one, wreaths and all. Not all of them. The fight is Thinned: one enemy fewer in each group. GO TO Dead Reckoning.

ev:6-the-last-customer:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:6-the-last-customer:mountains.html:
A rope bridge spans the ravine. On the far side, a row of skeletons in rusted mail sits beneath a toll board. The painted price has peeled away. As you approach, one raises an empty palm; another points helpfully at a heap of bones below the sign.

Choose one
  • Walk across without breaking stride, as if you had already paid. Trial 5 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO waved through. If you fail, GO TO a faltering step.
  • (Everyone loses 2 gold) Toss your coins onto the heap below the sign. GO TO counting the toll.
  • Draw your weapons and cross. GO TO The Old Toll.

ev:6-the-last-customer:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:6-the-last-customer:oceans.html:
A cluster of wooden coffins drifts across your course. Each bears a little wreath of salt-stiffened flowers. You reach for something to push them clear, then pause. Against the slap of the waves, you think you hear knocking.

Choose one
  • Watch the lids before you touch them. Trial 4 MIND (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO fingers on the lids. If you fail, GO TO the lids fly open.
  • (Spend a SOUL card) Say the words their mourners left unsaid. Trial 5 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO laid to rest. If you fail, GO TO Dead Reckoning.
  • Push them clear with the oars, and meet whatever climbs out. GO TO Dead Reckoning.

ev:6-the-last-customer:plains.title: Plains
ev:6-the-last-customer:plains.html:
Squinting against the evening sun, you spot a plume of smoke billowing near the horizon. As you approach cautiously, the faint sounds of conversation tell you of a trading caravan drafting guard duties for the night. By the tracks in the grass, someone has been following it for days, and keeping well out of sight.

Choose one
  • Approach the traders openly. GO TO Approaching the Traders.
  • (+1 curse) Wait until dusk, and sneak past the guards to steal the merchant's wares. GO TO Lightened Purses.

ev:6-the-last-customer:the-bear-necessit.title: The Bear Necessities
ev:6-the-last-customer:the-bear-necessit.html:
The bear rears up over the scattered provisions, and the wolves settle down at the edge of the clearing to see who's left when it's over.

The Bear Necessities
Quarter
EnemyExtra Lives
Towering Beast (#6)
Full Moon
Enemy
Pack Predator (#2)
Additional Rules
  • The Pack Predators are waiting for leftovers: when the Towering Beast dies, they slink off, and you win.
Outcome
Victory
  • 1x random Common Food item, from what the bear left.
  • 2 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 1 curse for each player.
  • Players lose 1x Food item.
  • 3 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:6-the-last-customer:the-lids-fly-open.html: You lean out for a better look, and the nearest lid flies open in your face. The fight starts Ambushed: every enemy starts one moon phase earlier. GO TO Dead Reckoning.

ev:6-the-last-customer:the-wolves-go-in.html: The wolves take the call, and go for the bear in a snarling rush. By the time it has thrown them off, it's bleeding, and furious, and it has noticed you. The Towering Beast starts the fight with no extra life. GO TO The Bear Necessities.

ev:6-the-last-customer:the-wolves-turn.html: The wolves know a false leader when they hear one, and more of them come out of the trees to see who's calling. The fight is Reinforced: one enemy more in each group. GO TO The Bear Necessities.

ev:6-the-last-customer:towns.title: Towns
ev:6-the-last-customer:towns.html:
Bunting stretches across the square. Beneath it, a tired official scratches a previous winner's name off a little wooden plaque. He notices you watching and brightens.

“New contestants! Splendid. The locals have become rather difficult to impress.”

Choose one
  • Walk on before he announces your names. STOP READING.
  • Enter the contest. If this town is adjacent to Mountains, GO TO the stone lifting contest. Otherwise, GO TO the pepper eating contest.

links.clause: If this town is adjacent to Mountains

ev:6-the-last-customer:waved-through.html: The captain lowers its palm and waves you on. You're past the last of them before some rusted bookkeeping inside its skull comes up short. The fight starts with Surprise: every enemy starts one moon phase later. GO TO The Old Toll.

ev:6-the-last-customer:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:6-the-last-customer:woodlands.html:
A torn pack hangs from a low branch. Beneath it, a bear noses through scattered provisions while wolves wait at a respectful distance. Something useful still bulges inside the canvas, just beyond the bear's reach. Yours, too, unless you leave the cover of the trees.

Choose one
  • Creep towards the pack. Trial 5 BODY (Cunning). If you succeed, GO TO recover the torn pack. If you fail, GO TO a cracking branch.
  • Howl like the pack's leader, and set the wolves on the bear. Trial 5 SOUL (Might). If you succeed, GO TO the wolves go in. If you fail, GO TO the wolves turn.
  • Charge the bear. GO TO The Bear Necessities.

ev:61-sea-land-and-sky:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:61-sea-land-and-sky:deserts.html:
The sand forgives nothing. The days burn, the nights freeze, and the dunes move when you aren't looking.

Choose one
  • Look for shade in a dry riverbed. Trial 6 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, everyone may rest sheltered. If you fail, exhaustion causes you to take an injury. STOP READING.
  • Pray to Adrai'lalth over the sacred sands. Trial 6 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, everyone recovers a spent card. If you fail, +1 curse. STOP READING.
  • Follow the stars. Trial 6 MIND (Lore). If you succeed, move to an adjacent location along a road. If you fail, move to a random adjacent location. STOP READING.
  • (If you have an ocean or river nearby) Head for the water. GO TO Setting Sail.
  • Walk on. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you have an ocean or river nearby) Head for the water

ev:61-sea-land-and-sky:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:61-sea-land-and-sky:mountains.html:
The peaks don't care that you came. Every step up is paid for in breath, and the mountain answers with its own: the hissing whisper of its ancient, volcanic blood.

Choose one
  • Bathe in the hot springs. Trial 5 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, recover a spent card. STOP READING.
  • (Spend a card) Climb to the ridge. Everyone gains 2 EXP. STOP READING.
  • (If you have an ocean or river nearby) Head for the water. GO TO Setting Sail.
  • Walk on. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you have an ocean or river nearby) Head for the water

ev:61-sea-land-and-sky:plains.title: Plains
ev:61-sea-land-and-sky:plains.html:
Grass runs to the edge of the world, and the wind combs it in long silver waves. There's nothing to hide behind out here, and nothing that needs to.

Choose one
  • Forage along the hedgerows. You gain Fruit (Common Food #2). STOP READING.
  • Stop, and take in the view. Everyone gains 1 EXP. STOP READING.
  • (If you have an ocean or river nearby) Head for the water. GO TO Setting Sail.
  • Walk on. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you have an ocean or river nearby) Head for the water

ev:61-sea-land-and-sky:sea-land-and-sky.title: Sea, Land and Sky
ev:61-sea-land-and-sky:sea-land-and-sky.html:
Every land has its ways, and those who travel it long enough learn them.

Read the section for your current terrain.

ev:61-sea-land-and-sky:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:61-sea-land-and-sky:woodlands.html:
The trees close overhead, and the light turns green and patient. The wood gives freely, to those who know where to look.

Choose one
  • Gather roots and mushrooms. You gain Bundle of Vegetables (Common Food #4). STOP READING.
  • Climb to the treetops. Trial 5 BODY (Athletics). If you succeed, look at the top two cards of the adventure deck and move any number of them to the bottom. STOP READING.
  • (If you have an ocean or river nearby) Head for the water. GO TO Setting Sail.
  • Walk on. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you have an ocean or river nearby) Head for the water

ev:62-town-and-country:deserts.title: Deserts
ev:62-town-and-country:deserts.html:
This is a caravanserai around a deep well, walled against the sand. Here, water is worth more than gold.

You may buyPrice
Sturdy Tent (Common Travel #1)2 gold
Compass (Common Travel #3)3 gold
Sand Nomad Robes (Uncommon Travel #1)7 gold

You may sell Waterskin and Fruit at five times their value.

Choose one
  • Browse the bazaar of the far roads. GO TO Bazaar of the Far Roads.
  • Sit with the nomad elders. GO TO the nomad elders.
  • Tell your stories. Trial 6 MIND (Influence). GO TO travel stories.
  • (-3 gold) Rent a room. GO TO a room for the night.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:62-town-and-country:mountains.title: Mountains
ev:62-town-and-country:mountains.html:
This is a quarry town, grey with stone dust, where the smiths rework whatever steel comes their way.

You may buyPrice
Climbing Rope (Common Travel #5)1 gold
Fur Pelts (Common Travel #6)6 gold
Journeyman's Belt (Common Travel #2)1 gold

You may sell any Armor to the smiths at its full value.

Choose one
  • (Spend a card) Work a shift at the quarries. Trial 6 SOUL (Resolve). GO TO a shift at the quarries.
  • Drink with the miners. GO TO drink with the miners.
  • (-2 gold) Rent a room. GO TO a room with a view.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:62-town-and-country:oceans.title: Oceans
ev:62-town-and-country:oceans.html:
This is a harbour town, all salt and tar. Nets dry on every wall, and the catch is sold before it stops moving.

You may buyPrice
Platefin (Common Food #1)2 gold
Horned Salmon (Uncommon Food #2)4 gold
Shimmerscale (Uncommon Food #5)5 gold

You may sell any Travel item to the sailors at full value.

Choose one
  • Visit the chandler. GO TO The Chandler.
  • (At a landing) Hire a ship. GO TO the harbour.
  • Drink with the sailors. GO TO drink with the sailors.
  • (-2 gold) Rent a room. GO TO a room for the night.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:62-town-and-country:plains.title: Plains
ev:62-town-and-country:plains.html:
This is a market town at a crossroads, ringed by fields. Carts creak in from every farm around, heavy with the harvest, and the farmers shout their prices over each other.

You may buyPrice
Tough Jerky (Common Food #5)2 gold
Eggs (Common Food #3)2 gold
Bundle of Vegetables (Common Food #4)2 gold
Fruit (Common Food #2)1 gold

You may sell any Food item to the market at its full value.

Choose one
  • (Spend a card) Help with the harvest. GO TO help with the harvest.
  • Drink with the drovers. GO TO drink with the drovers.
  • (-1 gold) Rent a room. GO TO a room for the night.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:62-town-and-country:town-and-country.title: Town and Country
ev:62-town-and-country:town-and-country.html: No two towns are alike: every town lives off the land around it. Read the section for any one terrain adjacent to this town. If the town stands on a river, you may go down to the river quay instead: GO TO the river quay.

links.clause: If the town stands on a river

ev:62-town-and-country:woodlands.title: Woodlands
ev:62-town-and-country:woodlands.html:
This is a town of timber and sawdust at the edge of the trees. Axes ring from dawn to dusk, and at night, the hunters keep watch for what comes out of the woods.

You may buyPrice
Fur Pelts (Common Travel #6)6 gold
Outrider's Whistle (Uncommon Travel #3)5 gold
Fishing Pole (Uncommon Travel #6)7 gold
Longbow (Common Weapon #6)3 gold

You may sell any Weapon to the hunters at its full value.

Choose one
  • Visit the woodcarvers. GO TO The Woodcarvers.
  • (Spend a card) Work the timber. Trial 6 BODY (Might). GO TO work the timber.
  • Listen to the woodsmen's tales. GO TO woodsmen's tales.
  • (-2 gold) Rent a room. GO TO a room for the night.
  • (-1 gold) Work for a bed. GO TO work for your lodging.
  • Leave. STOP READING.

ev:63-temple-of-fire:after-the-bath.html:
The hall feels chilly on your scalded skin. Those who built this bath were a proud race of warriors, and you know with certainty that they are gone.

You gain 3 EXP for each injury you took in the bath. With 3 or more, you may take a scorched iron collar from the bathers' offerings: gain Berserker's Collar (Unique Armor #4). With 4 or more, gold-veined black marble spreads over your arms, like the sleeves of the bathers on the walls: gain Flametouched Tattoos (Unique Armor #5). STOP READING.

ev:63-temple-of-fire:temple-of-fire.title: Temple of Fire
ev:63-temple-of-fire:temple-of-fire.html:
Rumours

Miners speak of a temple floating over a sleeping volcano, moored to the crater by bridges of black stone. Those who drink from its bowl come back harder than rock, if they come back at all.

Two mountain ridges run side by side, jagged teeth scraping the sky like the jaws of a buried leviathan, and open onto a caldera carved by forces so vast they border on the divine. Magma pulses white-hot under its crust. Above its centre floats a somber marble temple, glowing with the same lazy pulses, moored to the crater's edge by dozens of basalt bridges.

The heat on the bridge is near unbearable. At its end, a basalt door twice the height of a man stands half open under an inscription. You can't read the script, but the Shackle stirs and understands it for you: the temple is to be entered alone.

If you already freed the Witness of Fire, GO TO the cold temple.

Choose one
  • (Each player without the mark of fire, once per day) Slip through the door alone. GO TO the bowl.
  • (Everyone with the mark of fire) Enter together. GO TO the baths.
  • Turn back. You may move to an adjacent location, even if no roads connect to it. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you already freed the Witness of Fire

ev:63-temple-of-fire:the-bath.html:
You lower yourself into the magma, biting back a scream. Were it not for the Shackle, you'd melt on the spot. Then the pain turns numb, and memories that aren't yours rise with the heat: the ring of forges, rage, pride.

Stay in as long as you dare. Each time, take an injury, then a Trial 10 BODY + SOUL (Resolve). Climb out when you fail, or whenever you choose to. Then GO TO after the bath.

ev:63-temple-of-fire:the-baths.html:
The bowl is gone, and so is the carving of the drinking man. In their place, a passage leads through the hot rock to a hall like a bath house: pools of magma between marble screens carved with men and women bathing in liquid stone. Beyond them, filling half the hall, a salamander of dark rock lies coiled in sleep, its scales pulsing a faint red. It isn't only a statue.

Choose one
  • (Each player, once per day) Step into a pool. GO TO the bath.
  • Meditate before the salamander. GO TO the salamander.
  • (Unless you already struck the salamander) Strike its head with all your strength. GO TO the strike.
  • (Unless you already read the reliefs at this location) Study the reliefs. Trial 12 SOUL + MIND (Lore). If you succeed, GO TO the reliefs. If you fail, GO TO the carvings keep their secrets.
  • Leave the temple. STOP READING.

ev:63-temple-of-fire:the-bowl.html:
The door grinds shut behind you. As your eyes adjust, the dark becomes a round chamber with a single feature: a marble bowl brimming with molten rock, lighting reliefs of ancient figures in the middle of some ritual.

Choose one
  • Lift the bowl to your lips. If it worked for the figures on the walls, it should work for an unfortunate immortal like you. GO TO the drink.
  • Push the door open again, and leave. Trial 10 BODY (Might). If you succeed, you force your way back out into the heat. STOP READING. If you fail, choose a different option.

links.clause: If it worked for the figures on the walls

ev:63-temple-of-fire:the-drink.html:
Your palms sizzle on the bowl, and the Shackle rebuilds them as fast as they burn. At the first sip, your whole body bursts into flame.

You take an injury. Then take a Trial 8 SOUL (Resolve). If you succeed, GO TO the mark. If you fail, your arms give out and the bowl clatters back onto its plinth. From the walls comes a feeling you can't mistake: scorn. The door slides open. STOP READING.

ev:63-temple-of-fire:the-mark.html:
You close your mind to the agony and drain the bowl. Your insides burn away and rebuild into something as hard as volcanic rock, and the pain turns into a euphoria so fierce that a roar tears out of you. When you touch your tongue, it feels like polished marble.

Spend all of your cards. You gain 5 EXP. You now bear the mark of fire. The door swings open. The temple will welcome you back, but now it's time to rest. STOP READING.

ev:63-temple-of-fire:the-strike.html:
The rock doesn't crack. It rings like a bell in an empty cathedral, long after it should have stopped, and deep inside the stone something vast flinches. Far away, other bells ring in answer.

You take an injury. Everyone gains 4 EXP. You struck the salamander. STOP READING.

ev:64-emberskitter-nest:emberskitter-nes.title: Emberskitter Nest
ev:64-emberskitter-nest:emberskitter-nes.html:
Rumours

Caravans give a wide berth to a stretch of dunes where the sand clicks at night, and glows. The few who went to look came back without their eyebrows. Something down there sleeps on a bed of gold, they say, and its children are sparks.

You smell it before you see it: hot glass and sulphur, on a wind that should be cold at this hour. Past the next dune, the sand slopes down into a crater riddled with burrows, each one rimmed with glass where the sand has melted. From inside them comes a clicking, like a thousand tongues against a thousand teeth.

If you already killed the Matriarch at this location, GO TO the cold nest.

Choose one
  • (Once per day) Chip the glass from the rims of the burrows. GO TO the rims.
  • Go down into the tunnels. GO TO the tunnels.
  • (If you already cleared the tunnels at this location) Follow the heat down to the brood chamber. GO TO the brood chamber.
  • (If you already burned the brood at this location) Go down to where the heat comes from. GO TO the Matriarch.
  • Leave. You may move to an adjacent location, even if no roads connect to it. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you already killed the Matriarch at this location
If you already cleared the tunnels at this location) Follow the heat down to the brood chamber
If you already burned the brood at this location) Go down to where the heat comes from

ev:64-emberskitter-nest:the-brood-chambe.html:
The tunnel opens into a cavern studded with egg sacs the size of barrels, each pulsing like a coal someone forgot to put out. Some are already splitting.

Burn the Brood
Crescent
Enemy

Quarter

Outcome

  • You burned the brood.
  • 1x random Rare Armor, from the last party that tried.
  • 6 exp for each player.
Defeat

If you won, the deepest tunnel breathes out heat like a forge. Something in it, something vast, clicks once, and waits. STOP READING.

ev:64-emberskitter-nest:the-matriarch.html:
The last tunnel ends in a hollow of black glass, hot as an oven. She lies coiled on a hoard of coins fused into one glittering slab: a spider the size of a wagon, her silk running molten from her spinnerets. Sparks crawl over her back, and every one of them has legs.

Brood Mother
Crescent
Enemy
Emberskitter Spiderlings (#19)
Quarter

Emberskitter Sack (#20)
Full Moon

Outcome
Victory
  • You killed the Matriarch.
  • Her hoard: 20 gold, and Roadscorch (Unique Armor #2), boots still warm from her silk.
  • 8 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 12 exp for each player.

After the encounter, STOP READING.

ev:64-emberskitter-nest:the-rims.html:
The glass comes away in curls, amber and black, and the clicking below stops, as if something is listening.

Roll the luck die. If 1-3, sparks boil out of the nearest burrow and chase you up the dune: everyone takes an injury. STOP READING. If 4-10, you gain 4 gold in glass. STOP READING.

ev:64-emberskitter-nest:the-tunnels.html:
The burrows join into tunnels lined with glass that glows faintly from within. It gets hotter with every step, and the clicking comes from everywhere at once. Then the walls start to move.

Kindling
Quarter
Enemy
5×Emberskitter Spiderlings (#19)
Outcome
Victory
  • You cleared the tunnels.
  • 6 gold, in glass beads.
  • 5 exp for each player.
Defeat
  • 8 exp for each player.

If you won, the way down lies open, and from below comes a slow pulse, like a heart made of coals. STOP READING.

ev:65-bone-weaver-s-barrow:bone-weaver-s.title: Bone Weaver's Barrow
ev:65-bone-weaver-s-barrow:bone-weaver-s.html:
Rumours

Shepherds won't graze near the old king's barrow any more. At night the grass around it is pressed flat in wide circles, as if something heavy walked there until dawn, and the king's champion has been seen at its door, still keeping watch in his rusted mail.

The barrow rises out of the grass like the shoulder of a sleeping giant, ringed by standing stones. The grass around it lies pressed flat in wide, patient circles. The slab over its door, carved with a crowned king, has been rolled aside. From the inside.

If you already destroyed the Weaver, GO TO the quiet barrow.

Choose one
  • Go down into the barrow. GO TO the halls of the dead.
  • (If you already quieted the halls at this location) Go on to the champion's hall. GO TO the champion.
  • (If you already passed the champion) Go down to the king's tomb. GO TO the king's tomb.
  • Leave. You may move to an adjacent location, even if no roads connect to it. STOP READING.

links.clause: If you already destroyed the Weaver
If you already quieted the halls at this location) Go on to the champion's hall
If you already passed the champion) Go down to the king's tomb

ev:65-bone-weaver-s-barrow:duty-unto-dea.title: Duty Unto Death
ev:65-bone-weaver-s-barrow:duty-unto-dea.html:
He raises the sword, and the bones in the niches raise theirs.

Duty Unto Death
Crescent
Enemy
4×Raised Bones (#3)

Outcome

  • You passed the champion. His armour falls empty.

  • 9 exp for each player.

If you won, the door to the tomb stands open. The air beyond it is so cold it burns. STOP READING.

ev:65-bone-weaver-s-barrow:the-champion.html:
A warrior in rusted mail stands before the door to the tomb, leaning on a greatsword. Blue light burns in his eye sockets, but his jaw works as if he's trying to speak. The necromancer's leash is on him too.

Choose one
  • Remind him of the oath he swore his king. Trial 10 SOUL (Influence). If you succeed, GO TO the champion steps aside. If you fail, GO TO Duty Unto Death.
  • Fight him. GO TO Duty Unto Death.
  • Back away. STOP READING.

ev:65-bone-weaver-s-barrow:the-halls-of-.html:
Niches line the halls, one for every warrior who followed the king into the dark. They're all empty. The bones are standing in the middle of the hall, waiting, and they all turn to face you at once.

The Honour Guard
Quarter

Outcome

  • You quieted the halls.
  • 1x random Uncommon Armor, from the niches.
  • 5 exp for each player.

ev:65-bone-weaver-s-barrow:the-king-s-to.html:
The king lies on his bier. Something else sits on his throne: a thing of bones knotted together with threads of bone, stitching a new servant out of the old king's ribs, and humming. It stops humming when it sees you.

The Bone Weaver
